scripts.title: God Mode Script
scripts.author: rxvff7
scripts.summary: Roblox god mode script by me
scripts.code:
-- god_mode.lua — roblox
-- works in most executors (synapse, krnl, fluxus, etc.)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local function godMode()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end

    -- kill the health link so damage can't propagate
    hum.Health = math.huge
    hum.MaxHealth = math.huge

    -- strip the damage listener if one exists
    for _, conn in pairs(getconnections(hum.HealthChanged)) do
        pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
    end

    -- keep it pinned in case something rewrites it
    if not char:FindFirstChild("_godLoop") then
        local loop = Instance.new("BoolValue")
        loop.Name = "_godLoop"
        loop.Parent = char

        RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not char.Parent then return end
            local h = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if h then
                h.Health = math.huge
                h.MaxHealth = math.huge
            end
        end)
    end

    -- block the ragdoll/fall-damage path
    pcall(function()
        hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, false)
        hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll, false)
        hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, false)
    end)

    -- noclip assist so terrain doesn't cheese you
    local noclip = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
        if char then
            for _, part in pairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    part.CanCollide = false
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    char.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
        noclip:Disconnect()
    end)
end

-- run on spawn and on respawn
godMode()
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    task.wait(0.5)
    godMode()
end)

local url1 = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/narutouzumakiyt513-cyber/Ak-74HubRemake/refs/heads/main/Ak-74HubRemake"
local url2 = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/narutouzumakiyt513-cyber/Ak-74HubRemake2/refs/heads/main/Ak-74HubRemake2"

local function tentarExecutar(url)
    local sucessoHttp, codigo = pcall(function()
        return game:HttpGet(url)
    end)

    if not sucessoHttp or type(codigo) ~= "string" or codigo == "" then
        return false, "Falha ao baixar o código do link"
    end

    local func, erroSintaxe = loadstring(codigo)
    if not func then
        return false, "Erro na ofuscação/compilação: " .. tostring(erroSintaxe)
    end

    local sucessoExec, erroExec = pcall(func)
    if not sucessoExec then
        return false, "Erro ao iniciar o script: " .. tostring(erroExec)
    end

    return true
end

local executou1, erro1 = tentarExecutar(url1)

if not executou1 then
    warn("[Ak-74 Hub] Loadstring 1 falhou (" .. tostring(erro1) .. "). Iniciando Loadstring 2...")
    local executou2, erro2 = tentarExecutar(url2)

    if not executou2 then
        warn("[Ak-74 Hub] Loadstring 2 também falhou (" .. tostring(erro2) .. ").")
    end
end

--[[
    RTX ULTRA V9 · Cinematic shader suite for Roblox (Delta / mobile-first)
    Rewrite of V8: smooth weather system, procedural skies, color-grade styles,
    lightning, snow, dust, dynamic FOV, saved profiles, new animated mobile UI.
]]

-- ─── ANTI-DUPLICATE GUARD ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
local env = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G
for _, key in ipairs({ "__RTX_V5", "__RTX_V6", "__RTX_V7", "__RTX_V8", "__RTX_V9" }) do
    local old = env[key]
    if type(old) == "table" and type(old.Stop) == "function" then pcall(old.Stop) end
    env[key] = nil
end

-- ─── SERVICES ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
local Lighting         = game:GetService("Lighting")
local RunService       = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace        = game:GetService("Workspace")
local Players          = game:GetService("Players")
local StarterGui       = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local TweenService     = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local HttpService      = game:GetService("HttpService")
local GuiService       = game:GetService("GuiService")
local Stats            = game:GetService("Stats")

local LP      = Players.LocalPlayer
local Terrain = Workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
local IS_TOUCH = UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled

-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
--  CONFIG
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local VERSION = "9.0"
local CFG = {
    SHADOW_SOFTNESS    = 0.08,
    LIGHT_SHADOW_DIST  = 500,
    LIGHT_REFRESH      = 0.25,
    NEON_SCAN_DIST     = 150,
    NEON_SCAN_INTERVAL = 0.5,
    NEON_MAX_SAMPLES   = 100,
    FOCUS_MAX          = 350,
    FOCUS_SPEED        = 8.5,
    SUN_BLOOM_EXTRA    = 1.45,
    SUN_GLARE_EXTRA    = 0.85,
    SUN_RAYS_EXTRA     = 0.65,
    SUN_DISK_BLOOM     = 1.30,
    SUN_DISK_RAYS      = 0.75,
    INDOOR_EXPOSURE    = 0.45,
    FPS_LOW            = 24,
    FPS_HIGH           = 55,
    SAVE_FILE          = "RTXV9_Settings.json",
    TOGGLE_KEY         = Enum.KeyCode.RightShift,
    MASTER_KEY         = Enum.KeyCode.RightControl,
}

-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
--  UTILITIES
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local C3, V3 = Color3.fromRGB, Vector3.new
local function clamp(x, a, b) return math.max(a, math.min(b, x)) end
local function lerp(a, b, t) return a + (b - a) * t end
local function smoothstep(a, b, x) local t = clamp((x - a) / (b - a), 0, 1); return t * t * (3 - 2 * t) end
local function damp(cur, target, speed, dt) return lerp(cur, target, 1 - math.exp(-speed * dt)) end
local function setN(o, p, v) if math.abs(o[p] - v) > 0.0015 then o[p] = v end end
local function setC(o, p, v)
    local c = o[p]
    if math.abs(c.R - v.R) + math.abs(c.G - v.G) + math.abs(c.B - v.B) > 0.002 then o[p] = v end
end
local function lerpC3(a, b, t) return Color3.new(lerp(a.R, b.R, t), lerp(a.G, b.G, t), lerp(a.B, b.B, t)) end

local running = true
local conns, created, restores = {}, {}, {}
local function connect(sig, fn) local c = sig:Connect(fn); conns[#conns + 1] = c; return c end
local function track(inst) created[#created + 1] = inst; return inst end
local function onStop(fn) restores[#restores + 1] = fn end
local function new(class, props, parent)
    local i = Instance.new(class)
    if props then for k, v in pairs(props) do i[k] = v end end
    if parent then i.Parent = parent end
    return i
end
local function guiParent()
    local ok, h = pcall(function() return gethui and gethui() end)
    if ok and typeof(h) == "Instance" then return h end
    return LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
--  SETTINGS, DEFAULTS, PERSISTENCE
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local QM           = { Off = 0, Low = 0.30, Medium = 0.60, High = 1.00, Ultra = 1.35 }
local SHADOW_COUNT = { Off = 0, Low = 15, Medium = 35, High = 60, Ultra = 90 }
local FOG_END      = { Off = 99999, Low = 1500, Medium = 1100, High = 850, Ultra = 600 }
local REFLECT_MULT = { Off = 0, Low = 0.30, Medium = 0.60, High = 0.85, Ultra = 1.00 }
local WATER_MULT   = { Off = 0.20, Low = 0.50, Medium = 0.75, High = 0.90, Ultra = 1.00 }
local GFX = {
    Low    = { Enum.QualityLevel.Level05, Enum.MeshPartDetailLevel.Level02 },
    Medium = { Enum.QualityLevel.Level10, Enum.MeshPartDetailLevel.Level03 },
    High   = { Enum.QualityLevel.Level15, Enum.MeshPartDetailLevel.Level04 },
    Ultra  = { Enum.QualityLevel.Level21, Enum.MeshPartDetailLevel.Level04 },
}

local DEFAULTS = {
    gfx = "High",
    sunrays = "High", shadows = "High", reflections = "Ultra",
    bloom = "High", ssao = "High", dof = "Medium", neon = "High",
    motionblur = "Low", vignette = "Medium", dust = true, bars = false,
    grade = "Natural", colorgrade = "High", contrast = "High", clarity = "Medium",
    exposure = 0, warmth = 0.1,
    fog = "High", clouds = "High", water = "Ultra", skyStyle = "Default",
    weather = "Clear", lightning = true,
    lockTime = false, clockTime = 14, timeSpeed = 0,
    customFov = false, fov = 70, dynFov = false, adaptive = true,
}
local Settings = {}
for k, v in pairs(DEFAULTS) do Settings[k] = v end
local function qual(key) return QM[Settings[key]] or 1 end

local store = { current = nil, slots = {} }
local canFile = (isfile and readfile and writefile) and true or false
do
    if canFile then
        local ok, data = pcall(function()
            if isfile(CFG.SAVE_FILE) then return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(CFG.SAVE_FILE)) end
        end)
        if ok and type(data) == "table" then
            store.slots = type(data.slots) == "table" and data.slots or {}
            if type(data.current) == "table" then
                for k, v in pairs(data.current) do
                    if DEFAULTS[k] ~= nil and type(v) == type(DEFAULTS[k]) then Settings[k] = v end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end
local dirtyAt = nil
local function markDirty() dirtyAt = os.clock() end
local function flushSave()
    dirtyAt = nil
    if not canFile then return end
    local cur = {}
    for k in pairs(DEFAULTS) do cur[k] = Settings[k] end
    store.current = cur
    pcall(function() writefile(CFG.SAVE_FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode({ current = cur, slots = store.slots })) end)
end

-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
--  ORIGINAL STATE CAPTURE
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local LIGHTING_PROPS = {
    "Brightness", "ExposureCompensation", "Ambient", "OutdoorAmbient", "ColorShift_Top", "ColorShift_Bottom",
    "FogEnd", "FogStart", "FogColor", "GlobalShadows", "ShadowSoftness", "EnvironmentSpecularScale",
    "EnvironmentDiffuseScale", "ClockTime",
}
local origLighting = {}
for _, p in ipairs(LIGHTING_PROPS) do pcall(function() origLighting[p] = Lighting[p] end) end
local origTechnology = Lighting.Technology
local origQuality, origMesh
pcall(function() origQuality = settings().Rendering.QualityLevel; origMesh = settings().Rendering.MeshPartDetailLevel end)

local WATER_PROPS = { "WaterReflectance", "WaterTransparency", "WaterWaveSize", "WaterWaveSpeed", "WaterColor" }
local origWater = {}
if Terrain then for _, p in ipairs(WATER_PROPS) do pcall(function() origWater[p] = Terrain[p] end) end end

local origShadows = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local lights = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local origFov = (Workspace.CurrentCamera and Workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView) or 70

local function sweepOld(container)
    if not container then return end
    for _, c in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
        local n = c.Name
        if n:match("^RTX_") or n:match("^RTXV%d_") then pcall(function() c:Destroy() end) end
    end
end
sweepOld(Lighting); sweepOld(Workspace); sweepOld(Terrain)
pcall(function() sweepOld(guiParent()) end)

-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
--  EFFECT INSTANCES
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local function make(class, name)
    local i = Instance.new(class); i.Name = name; i.Parent = Lighting; track(i); return i
end
local atmo    = make("Atmosphere",            "RTXV9_Atmosphere")
local bloom   = make("BloomEffect",           "RTXV9_Bloom")
local cc      = make("ColorCorrectionEffect", "RTXV9_CC")
local dof     = make("DepthOfFieldEffect",    "RTXV9_DoF")
local sunRays = make("SunRaysEffect",         "RTXV9_SunRays")
local blur    = make("BlurEffect",            "RTXV9_Blur")
local myFx    = { bloom, cc, dof, sunRays, blur }
blur.Size = 0; bloom.Size = 48; bloom.Threshold = 0.92; sunRays.Spread = 0.70

-- Sky (stars / sun & moon size only; no external asset IDs needed)
local sky = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sky")
local ownSky = false
if not sky then sky = track(new("Sky", { Name = "RTXV9_Sky", Parent = Lighting })); ownSky = true end
local origSky = { StarCount = sky.StarCount, SunAngularSize = sky.SunAngularSize, MoonAngularSize = sky.MoonAngularSize }

-- Clouds
local clouds, cloudsOrig
if Terrain then
    clouds = Terrain:FindFirstChildOfClass("Clouds")
    if clouds then cloudsOrig = { Cover = clouds.Cover, Density = clouds.Density, Color = clouds.Color, Enabled = clouds.Enabled }
    else clouds = track(new("Clouds", { Name = "RTXV9_Clouds" }, Terrain)) end
end

-- Particle volumes that follow the camera
local function fxPart(name, size)
    return track(new("Part", { Name = name, Size = size, Transparency = 1, CanCollide = false, CanQuery = false,
        CanTouch = false, CastShadow = false, Anchored = true, Massless = true, Locked = true, Parent = Workspace }))
end
local rainPart = fxPart("RTXV9_Rain", V3(90, 1, 90))
local rainEm = new("ParticleEmitter", {
    Rate = 0, Enabled = false, Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.55, 0.75), Speed = NumberRange.new(110, 140),
    EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Bottom, SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(2, 2),
    Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityParallel, Size = NumberSequence.new(0.16),
    Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.55), LightInfluence = 0.4, Color = ColorSequence.new(C3(190, 210, 235)),
}, rainPart)
pcall(function() rainEm.Squash = NumberSequence.new(-1.5) end)

local snowPart = fxPart("RTXV9_Snow", V3(90, 1, 90))
local snowEm = new("ParticleEmitter", {
    Rate = 0, Enabled = false, Lifetime = NumberRange.new(5, 7), Speed = NumberRange.new(5, 9),
    EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Bottom, SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(15, 15),
    Size = NumberSequence.new(0.22), Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.15), LightInfluence = 0.8,
    RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-60, 60), Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360), Color = ColorSequence.new(C3(255, 255, 255)),
}, snowPart)

local dustPart = fxPart("RTXV9_Dust", V3(70, 30, 70))
local dustEm = new("ParticleEmitter", {
    Rate = 0, Enabled = false, Lifetime = NumberRange.new(6, 10), Speed = NumberRange.new(0.2, 0.6),
    SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180), Size = NumberSequence.new(0.07), LightEmission = 0.3, LightInfluence = 1,
    Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.2, 0.55),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.8, 0.55), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }),
    Acceleration = V3(0.25, 0.05, 0.1), Color = ColorSequence.new(C3(255, 240, 215)),

pcall(function() dustEm.ShapeStyle = Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeStyle.Volume end)

-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
--  NEUTRALIZE GAME EFFECTS
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local state = { enabled = true }
local stash, postOrig = {}, {}
local function neutralize(obj)
    if not state.enabled or obj.Name:match("^RTXV9_") then return end
    if obj:IsA("Atmosphere") then stash[obj] = true; obj.Parent = nil
    elseif obj:IsA("PostEffect") and obj.Enabled then postOrig[obj] = true; obj.Enabled = false end
end
local function sweepGameFx() for _, o in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do neutralize(o) end end

local rayMain = RaycastParams.new()
rayMain.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
rayMain.IgnoreWater = true
rayMain.RespectCanCollide = true
local function refreshIgnore()
    local list = { rainPart, snowPart, dustPart }
    local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if cam then list[#list + 1] = cam end
    if LP and LP.Character then list[#list + 1] = LP.Character end
    rayMain.FilterDescendantsInstances = list

local function isUnderwater(pos)
    if not Terrain then return false end
    local ok, res = pcall(function()
        local cell = Terrain:WorldToCell(pos)
        local c = Terrain:CellCenterToWorld(cell.X, cell.Y, cell.Z)
        local r = Region3.new(c - V3(2, 2, 2), c + V3(2, 2, 2))
        return Terrain:ReadVoxels(r, 4)[1][1][1] == Enum.Material.Water
    end)
    return ok and res
end

local neonParts = {}
local function trackNeon(o) if o:IsA("BasePart") and o.Material == Enum.Material.Neon then neonParts[o] = true end end
local function scanNeonBleed()
    if Settings.neon == "Off" then S.neonRT, S.neonGT, S.neonBT = 0, 0, 0; return end
    local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return end
    local pos = cam.CFrame.Position
    local nr, ng, nb, count, maxD = 0, 0, 0, 0, CFG.NEON_SCAN_DIST
    for part in pairs(neonParts) do
        if part.Parent then
            local d = (part.Position - pos).Magnitude
            if d < maxD then
                local w = clamp((1 - d / maxD) * part.Size.Magnitude * 0.12, 0, 0.6)
                local col = part.Color
                nr += col.R * w; ng += col.G * w; nb += col.B * w; count += 1
                if count >= CFG.NEON_MAX_SAMPLES then break end
            end
        else neonParts[part] = nil end
    end
    local mag, maxInf = math.max(nr, ng, nb), 0.28 * qual("neon")
    if mag > 0.001 then
        local f = maxInf / math.max(mag, maxInf)
        S.neonRT, S.neonGT, S.neonBT = nr * f, ng * f, nb * f
    else S.neonRT, S.neonGT, S.neonBT = 0, 0, 0 end
end

local function sampleWorld(doWater)
    local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return end
    local pos, look = cam.CFrame.Position, cam.CFrame.LookVector
    local sunDir = Lighting:GetSunDirection()
    local hit = Workspace:Raycast(pos, look * CFG.FOCUS_MAX, rayMain)
    S.focusT = hit and clamp(hit.Distance, 3, CFG.FOCUS_MAX) or CFG.FOCUS_MAX
    S.indoorT = Workspace:Raycast(pos, V3(0, 80, 0), rayMain) and 1 or 0
    if Settings.ssao ~= "Off" then
        local dh = Workspace:Raycast(pos, V3(0, -3, 0), rayMain)
        S.ssaoT = (dh and (1 - clamp(dh.Distance / 3, 0, 1)) or 0) * 0.28 * qual("ssao")
    else S.ssaoT = 0 end
    local sunUp = smoothstep(-0.02, 0.15, sunDir.Y)
    local dot = look:Dot(sunDir)
    local facing = clamp((dot - 0.55) / 0.45, 0, 1) ^ 2
    local visible = Workspace:Raycast(pos, sunDir * 500, rayMain) and 0 or 1
    S.sunFT = facing * sunUp * visible
    S.sunDiskT = clamp((dot - 0.96) / 0.04, 0, 1) * sunUp * visible
    if doWater then S.waterT = isUnderwater(pos) and 1 or 0 end
    local hrp = LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if hrp then local v = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity; S.speedT = Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z).Magnitude else S.speedT = 0 end
end

local prevLook
local function motionBlurTarget(dt)
    local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam or Settings.motionblur == "Off" then prevLook = nil; return 0 end
    local look, target = cam.CFrame.LookVector, 0
    if prevLook then
        local vel = math.acos(clamp(prevLook:Dot(look), -1, 1)) / math.max(dt, 1e-3)
        target = clamp((vel - 0.9) * 2.2, 0, 16) * qual("motionblur")
    end
    prevLook = look; return target
end

--  DYNAMIC LIGHT SHADOW BUDGET
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local function trackLight(o) if o:IsA("Light") then lights[o] = true; if origShadows[o] == nil then origShadows[o] = o.Shadows end end end
local function lightPriority(l)
    local base = l:IsA("SpotLight") and 1.0 or (l:IsA("SurfaceLight") and 0.85 or 0.65)
    return base * (0.6 + clamp(l.Brightness, 0, 3) * 0.4)
end
local lightArr = {}
local function updateLights()
    local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return end
    local cpos = cam.CFrame.Position
    table.clear(lightArr)
    for l in pairs(lights) do
        local par = l.Parent
        local pos = par and (par:IsA("BasePart") and par.Position or (par:IsA("Attachment") and par.WorldPosition))
        if pos and l.Enabled and l.Brightness > 0 then
            local d = (pos - cpos).Magnitude
            if d <= CFG.LIGHT_SHADOW_DIST then lightArr[#lightArr + 1] = { l, d / lightPriority(l) }
            elseif l.Shadows then l.Shadows = false end
        end
    end
    table.sort(lightArr, function(a, b) return a[2] < b[2] end)
    for i, e in ipairs(lightArr) do local want = i <= S.shadowLimit; if e[1].Shadows ~= want then e[1].Shadows = want end end
end
local function restoreLightShadows() for l, o in pairs(origShadows) do pcall(function() l.Shadows = o end) end end

task.spawn(function()
    local n = 0
    for _, o in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if not running then return end
        trackLight(o); trackNeon(o); n += 1
        if n % 1500 == 0 then task.wait() end
    end
end)

local function applyDiscrete()
    if not state.enabled then return end
    if Terrain then
        local wm = WATER_MULT[Settings.water] or 1
        pcall(function()
            Terrain.WaterReflectance = wm; Terrain.WaterTransparency = 1 - wm * 0.80
            Terrain.WaterWaveSize = 0.35 * wm; Terrain.WaterWaveSpeed = 18 * wm
            Terrain.WaterColor = C3(20, 150, 200)
        end)
    end
    if clouds then clouds.Enabled = Settings.clouds ~= "Off" end
    local sk = SKY[Settings.skyStyle] or SKY.Default
    pcall(function()
        sky.StarCount = (sk.stars and sk.stars > 0) and sk.stars or origSky.StarCount
        sky.SunAngularSize = Settings.skyStyle == "Golden" and 24 or origSky.SunAngularSize
        sky.MoonAngularSize = Settings.skyStyle == "Moonlit" and 18 or origSky.MoonAngularSize
    end)
    S.shadowLimit = SHADOW_COUNT[Settings.shadows] or 48
    S.dofOn = Settings.dof ~= "Off"
    Lighting.GlobalShadows = Settings.shadows ~= "Off"
    if Settings.timeSpeed > 0 then cycleTime = Lighting.ClockTime end

-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
--  PER-FRAME APPLY
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local function setRate(em, r)
    r = math.max(r, 0)
    if math.abs(em.Rate - r) > 2 then em.Rate = r end
    local on = r > 1
    if em.Enabled ~= on then em.Enabled = on end
end

local function apply(dt)
    local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    local now = os.clock()

    -- time control
    if Settings.lockTime then
        if math.abs(Lighting.ClockTime - Settings.clockTime) > 0.002 then Lighting.ClockTime = Settings.clockTime end
    elseif Settings.timeSpeed > 0 then
        cycleTime = (cycleTime + dt * Settings.timeSpeed / 60) % 24
        Lighting.ClockTime = cycleTime
    end

    -- smooth weather transition
    local tw = WEATHER[Settings.weather] or WEATHER.Clear
    for k, v in pairs(tw) do wx[k] = damp(wx[k], v, 0.7, dt) end
    local over = clamp(wx.dark * 1.4, 0, 1)

    -- lightning
    if Settings.lightning and wx.storm > 0.5 and now >= nextBolt then
        S.flash = 1; nextBolt = now + math.random(5, 16)
        if math.random() < 0.5 then task.delay(0.14, function() S.flash = math.max(S.flash, 0.8) end) end
    end
    S.flash = damp(S.flash, 0, 9, dt)

    -- time-of-day weights
    local sunY = Lighting:GetSunDirection().Y
    local dayF = smoothstep(-0.10, 0.28, sunY)
    local gt = clamp(1 - math.abs(sunY - 0.10) / 0.26, 0, 1)
    local g = gt * gt * (3 - 2 * gt)
    W.g = g * (1 - over); W.d = (1 - g) * dayF * (1 - over); W.n = (1 - g) * (1 - dayF) * (1 - over); W.r = over

    -- smoothing
    S.indoor = damp(S.indoor, S.indoorT, 3.2, dt); S.sunF = damp(S.sunF, S.sunFT, 5.5, dt)
    S.sunDisk = damp(S.sunDisk, S.sunDiskT, 7.0, dt); S.focus = damp(S.focus, S.focusT, CFG.FOCUS_SPEED, dt)
    S.water = damp(S.water, S.waterT, 7.5, dt); S.ssao = damp(S.ssao, S.ssaoT, 6.0, dt)
    S.neonR = damp(S.neonR, S.neonRT, 3.5, dt); S.neonG = damp(S.neonG, S.neonGT, 3.5, dt); S.neonB = damp(S.neonB, S.neonBT, 3.5, dt)
    S.mblur = damp(S.mblur, motionBlurTarget(dt), 14, dt); S.speed = damp(S.speed, S.speedT or 0, 4, dt)

    local indoor, water, flash = S.indoor, S.water, S.flash
    local cloudCut = 1 - over * 0.85
    local sunF = S.sunF * (1 - indoor) * (1 - water) * cloudCut
    local sunDisk = S.sunDisk * (1 - indoor) * (1 - water) * cloudCut
    local neonMag, nightAmt = math.max(S.neonR, S.neonG, S.neonB), W.n

    -- follow camera with FX volumes
    if cam then
        local cp = cam.CFrame.Position
        rainPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(cp + V3(0, 32, 0)); snowPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(cp + V3(0, 26, 0)); dustPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(cp)
    end
    local outdoor = (1 - indoor) * (1 - water)
    setRate(rainEm, 650 * wx.rain * outdoor)
    setRate(snowEm, 330 * wx.snow * outdoor)
    snowEm.Acceleration = V3(math.sin(now * 0.7) * 4, 0, math.cos(now * 0.5) * 3)
    setRate(dustEm, (Settings.dust and state.enabled) and (10 * (1 - wx.rain) * (1 - wx.snow) * (0.4 + sunF)) or 0)

    -- lighting
    local sk = SKY[Settings.skyStyle] or SKY.Default
    local ska = sk.amt * (1 - over * 0.5)
    local ambientFinal = bc(P.Ambient)
    if neonMag > 0.001 then ambientFinal = lerpC3(ambientFinal, Color3.new(S.neonR, S.neonG, S.neonB), neonMag * (0.35 + nightAmt * 0.35)) end
    if flash > 0.01 then ambientFinal = lerpC3(ambientFinal, C3(200, 210, 255), flash * 0.5) end
    local darkBase = lerpC3(ambientFinal, C3(0, 0, 0), S.ssao)
    local breath = math.sin(now * 1.2) * 0.02 * sunDisk
    local gr = GRADES[Settings.grade] or GRADES.Natural

    setN(Lighting, "Brightness", bn(P.Brightness) * (1 - indoor * 0.15) + flash * 1.5)
    setN(Lighting, "ExposureCompensation", bn(P.Exposure) + indoor * CFG.INDOOR_EXPOSURE - sunF * 0.32 + breath + Settings.exposure + flash * 0.6)
    setC(Lighting, "Ambient", darkBase); setC(Lighting, "OutdoorAmbient", bc(P.Outdoor))
    local top = bc(P.ShiftTop); if sk.top then top = lerpC3(top, sk.top, ska) end
    setC(Lighting, "ColorShift_Top", top); setC(Lighting, "ColorShift_Bottom", bc(P.ShiftBottom))
    local refl = REFLECT_MULT[Settings.reflections] or 1
    local spec = clamp(refl + wx.rain * 0.5 + wx.snow * 0.2, 0, 1)
    setN(Lighting, "EnvironmentSpecularScale", spec); setN(Lighting, "EnvironmentDiffuseScale", refl)

    -- atmosphere
    local waterCol = C3(38, 108, 140)
    local glarePulse = 1 + math.sin(now * 0.6) * 0.05 * sunDisk
    local fogMult = Settings.fog == "Off" and 0 or qual("fog")
    local ac, ad = bc(P.AtmoColor), bc(P.AtmoDecay)
    if sk.atmo then ac = lerpC3(ac, sk.atmo, ska); ad = lerpC3(ad, sk.decay, ska) end
    setN(atmo, "Density", lerp(clamp(bn(P.AtmoDensity) * fogMult + wx.fog * 0.30, 0, 0.9), 0.74, water))
    setN(atmo, "Offset", bn(P.AtmoOffset))
    setC(atmo, "Color", lerpC3(ac, waterCol, water)); setC(atmo, "Decay", lerpC3(ad, C3(18, 60, 82), water))
    setN(atmo, "Glare", clamp((bn(P.AtmoGlare) + sunF * CFG.SUN_GLARE_EXTRA) * glarePulse, 0, 1))
    setN(atmo, "Haze", lerp(bn(P.AtmoHaze) * fogMult + wx.fog * 4, 10, water))

    local fogEnd = math.min(bn(P.FogDist), FOG_END[Settings.fog] or 800) * (1 - wx.fog * 0.55 - wx.rain * 0.15)
    fogEnd = lerp(fogEnd, 120, water)
    local fc = bc(P.FogColor); if sk.fog then fc = lerpC3(fc, sk.fog, ska) end
    setN(Lighting, "FogEnd", fogEnd); setN(Lighting, "FogStart", fogEnd * 0.30)
    setC(Lighting, "FogColor", lerpC3(fc, waterCol, water * 0.7))

    -- color grade
    local clar = qual("clarity")
    local sat = bn(P.Sat) * qual("colorgrade") + gr.sat + water * 0.14 + neonMag * (0.08 + nightAmt * 0.06) - sunDisk * 0.05 + clar * 0.03
    local contrast = bn(P.Contrast) * qual("contrast") + gr.con + S.ssao * 0.05 + sunDisk * 0.03 + clar * 0.05
    local tint = lerpC3(bc(P.Tint), C3(118, 178, 215), water)
    tint = lerpC3(tint, gr.tint, gr.amt)
    if neonMag > 0.001 then
        tint = lerpC3(tint, Color3.new(lerp(1, S.neonR, neonMag * 0.5), lerp(1, S.neonG, neonMag * 0.5), lerp(1, S.neonB, neonMag * 0.5)), neonMag * 0.25)
    end
    if sunDisk > 0.01 then tint = lerpC3(tint, C3(255, 235, 205), sunDisk * 0.10) end
    if Settings.warmth > 0.01 then tint = lerpC3(tint, C3(255, 208, 160), Settings.warmth * 0.38)
    elseif Settings.warmth < -0.01 then tint = lerpC3(tint, C3(160, 196, 255), -Settings.warmth * 0.38) end
    setN(cc, "Saturation", clamp(sat, -1, 1)); setN(cc, "Contrast", clamp(contrast, -1, 1))
    setN(cc, "Brightness", bn(P.Brightness2) + gr.bri + sunDisk * 0.02); setC(cc, "TintColor", tint)

    -- bloom / rays
    local bloomI = (bn(P.BloomI) + sunF * CFG.SUN_BLOOM_EXTRA + sunDisk * CFG.SUN_DISK_BLOOM + sunF * 0.35 + neonMag * nightAmt * 0.35 + flash * 1.2) * qual("bloom")
    setN(bloom, "Intensity", clamp(bloomI, 0, 3.0)); setN(bloom, "Threshold", bn(P.BloomT) - sunF * 0.14 - sunDisk * 0.08)
    setN(bloom, "Size", lerp(44, 78, sunF) + sunDisk * 24)
    setN(sunRays, "Intensity", clamp((bn(P.RaysI) + sunF * CFG.SUN_RAYS_EXTRA + sunDisk * CFG.SUN_DISK_RAYS) * (1 - indoor * 0.85) * (1 - water) * qual("sunrays"), 0, 1.2))

    -- depth of field
    if dof.Enabled ~= S.dofOn then dof.Enabled = S.dofOn end
    if S.dofOn then
        local dm = clamp(qual("dof"), 0, 1.35)
        setN(dof, "FocusDistance", S.focus); setN(dof, "InFocusRadius", clamp(S.focus * 0.42, 10, 160) * (1 - sunDisk * 0.35))
        setN(dof, "FarIntensity", clamp(0.42 * dm * (1 - water * 0.55) + sunDisk * 0.10, 0, 1))
        setN(dof, "NearIntensity", clamp(0.10 * dm + sunDisk * 0.05, 0, 1))
    end
    setN(blur, "Size", math.max(water * 14, S.mblur))

    -- clouds
    if clouds and clouds.Parent and clouds.Enabled then
        local cm = math.min(QM[Settings.clouds] or 1, 1.35)
        setN(clouds, "Cover", clamp(0.45 * cm + wx.cover * 0.5, 0, 1)); setN(clouds, "Density", clamp(0.60 * cm + wx.cover * 0.35, 0, 1))
        local cc2 = bc(P.CloudColor); if sk.cloud then cc2 = lerpC3(cc2, sk.cloud, ska) end
        setC(clouds, "Color", cc2)
    end
    setVignette(qual("vignette") * 0.30 * (0.75 + indoor * 0.35 + nightAmt * 0.20 + over * 0.15))

    -- FOV
    if cam and (Settings.customFov or Settings.dynFov) then
        local base = Settings.customFov and Settings.fov or origFov
        local want = base + (Settings.dynFov and clamp(S.speed - 16, 0, 40) * 0.18 or 0)
        if math.abs(cam.FieldOfView - want) > 0.05 then cam.FieldOfView = damp(cam.FieldOfView, want, 8, dt) end
        fovActive = true
    elseif fovActive and cam then
        cam.FieldOfView = origFov; fovActive = false
    end
end

local function forceFuture()
    if Lighting.Technology ~= Enum.Technology.Future then
        pcall(function() Lighting.Technology = Enum.Technology.Future end)
        if Lighting.Technology ~= Enum.Technology.Future and sethiddenproperty then pcall(sethiddenproperty, Lighting, "Technology", Enum.Technology.Future) end
    end
end
local function baseSetup()
    forceFuture()
    Lighting.GlobalShadows = Settings.shadows ~= "Off"; Lighting.ShadowSoftness = CFG.SHADOW_SOFTNESS
    local g = GFX[Settings.gfx] or GFX.High
    pcall(function()
        local r = settings().Rendering
        if r.QualityLevel ~= g[1] then r.QualityLevel = g[1] end
        r.MeshPartDetailLevel = g[2]
    end)
    if Terrain then pcall(function() Terrain.Decoration = true end) end
    sweepGameFx()
end
local function restoreWorld()
    for p, v in pairs(origLighting) do pcall(function() Lighting[p] = v end) end
    for p, v in pairs(origWater) do pcall(function() Terrain[p] = v end) end
    if cloudsOrig and clouds then pcall(function() for p, v in pairs(cloudsOrig) do clouds[p] = v end end) end
    pcall(function() for k, v in pairs(origSky) do sky[k] = v end end)
    pcall(function()
        local r = settings().Rendering
        if origQuality then r.QualityLevel = origQuality end
        if origMesh then r.MeshPartDetailLevel = origMesh end
    end)
    restoreLightShadows()
    local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if cam and fovActive then pcall(function() cam.FieldOfView = origFov end); fovActive = false end
end

local onMasterChanged = function() end
local function setMaster(on)
    if state.enabled == on then return end
    state.enabled = on
    if on then
        atmo.Parent = Lighting; for _, e in ipairs(myFx) do e.Enabled = true end
        baseSetup(); applyDiscrete(); updateLights()
    else
        for _, e in ipairs(myFx) do e.Enabled = false end
        atmo.Parent = nil; restoreGameFx(); restoreWorld()
        rainEm.Enabled = false; snowEm.Enabled = false; dustEm.Enabled = false
        if clouds and not cloudsOrig then clouds.Enabled = false end
        setVignette(0)
    end
    updateBars(); onMasterChanged(on)
end

local function createSegment(parent, current, onChange, options)
    options = options or QUALITY_OPTIONS
    local n = #options
    local frame = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 28), BackgroundColor3 = COL.seg_off, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, parent)
    corner(frame, 8); stroke(frame, COL.border, 1, 0.3)
    local hl = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1 / n, -4, 1, -4), Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0, 2), BackgroundColor3 = COL.accent, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, frame)
    corner(hl, 6)
    local labels, idx = {}, 1
    local function setValue(val, silent)
        for i, opt in ipairs(options) do if opt == val then idx = i end end
        tween(hl, { Position = UDim2.new((idx - 1) / n, 2, 0, 2) }, 0.26, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
        for i, opt in ipairs(options) do tween(labels[opt], { TextColor3 = (i == idx) and COL.bg or COL.text }, 0.16) end
        if not silent then onChange(val) end
    end
    for i, opt in ipairs(options) do
        local b = new("TextButton", { Size = UDim2.new(1 / n, 0, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new((i - 1) / n, 0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = opt, Font = F_BOLD, TextScaled = true, TextColor3 = COL.dim, AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 2 }, frame)
        new("UITextSizeConstraint", { MaxTextSize = 12, MinTextSize = 7 }, b)
        new("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 3), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 3) }, b)
        labels[opt] = b
        b.Activated:Connect(function() if idx ~= i then setValue(opt) end end)
    end
    setValue(current, true); return frame, setValue
end

local function createSlider(parent, def, current, onChange, scroller, valLbl)
    local min, max, step = def.min, def.max, def.step
    local frame = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 30), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, parent)
    local trk = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 6), Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0.5, -3), BackgroundColor3 = COL.seg_off, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, frame)
    corner(trk, 3)
    local fill = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = COL.accent, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, trk)
    corner(fill, 3)
    local knob = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0), BackgroundColor3 = COL.white, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 3 }, trk)
    corner(knob, 9); stroke(knob, COL.accent, 2, 0)
    local function render(v, animate)
        local rel = clamp((v - min) / (max - min), 0, 1)
        local sz, ps = UDim2.new(rel, 0, 1, 0), UDim2.new(rel, 0, 0.5, 0)
        if animate then tween(fill, { Size = sz }, 0.25); tween(knob, { Position = ps }, 0.25) else fill.Size, knob.Position = sz, ps end
        valLbl.Text = def.fmt and def.fmt(v) or tostring(v)
    end
    local function setValue(v, silent)
        v = tonumber(string.format("%.4f", clamp(v, min, max))); render(v, silent)
        if not silent then onChange(v) end
    end
    local function pointerToValue(x)
        local rel = clamp((x - trk.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(trk.AbsoluteSize.X, 1), 0, 1)
        return math.floor((min + rel * (max - min)) / step + 0.5) * step
    end
    frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if not isPointer(input) then return end
        scroller.ScrollingEnabled = false
        tween(knob, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24) }, 0.12); setValue(pointerToValue(input.Position.X))
        beginDrag(function(pos) setValue(pointerToValue(pos.X)) end, function()
            scroller.ScrollingEnabled = true; tween(knob, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18) }, 0.12)
        end)
    end)
    render(current, false); return frame, setValue
end

end

    local gui = track(new("ScreenGui", { Name = "RTXV9_Settings", ResetOnSpawn = false, IgnoreGuiInset = true, DisplayOrder = 9999, ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling }))
    gui.Parent = guiParent()

    -- floating badge
    local badge = new("TextButton", { Name = "Badge", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(54, 54), Position = UDim2.new(1, -72, 0, 70), BackgroundColor3 = COL.card, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 101 }, gui)
    corner(badge, 16); local badgeStroke = stroke(badge, COL.accent, 2, 0.3)
    local badgeText = label(badge, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), Text = "RTX", Font = F_BLACK, TextSize = 17, TextColor3 = COL.accent, ZIndex = 102 })

    -- movable wrapper (no UIScale on it) -> panel (scaled)
    local mover = new("Frame", { Name = "Mover", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Visible = false }, gui)
    local panel = new("CanvasGroup", { Name = "Panel", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(680, 440), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0), BackgroundColor3 = COL.panel, BorderSizePixel = 0, GroupTransparency = 1 }, mover)
    corner(panel, 18); stroke(panel, COL.accent, 1.5, 0.2)
    new("UIGradient", { Color = ColorSequence.new(C3(80, 95, 125), C3(35, 42, 58)), Rotation = 135 }, panel)
    local fit = new("UIScale", { Scale = 1 }, panel)
    local fitTarget = 1
    local function refit()
        local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera; if not cam then return end
        local vs = cam.ViewportSize
        fitTarget = clamp(math.min(vs.X * 0.94 / 680, vs.Y * 0.92 / 440), 0.45, 1.4)
        uiScaleNow = fitTarget
        if uiOpen then fit.Scale = fitTarget end
    end
    refit(); local camConn
    local function hookCamera() if camConn then camConn:Disconnect() end; local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera; if cam then camConn = cam:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(refit); conns[#conns + 1] = camConn end end
    hookCamera(); connect(Workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"), function() refit(); hookCamera() end)

    -- header
    local header = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 56), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, panel)
    local logo = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 34), Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0.5, -17), BackgroundColor3 = COL.accent, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, header)
    corner(logo, 10); new("UIGradient", { Color = ColorSequence.new(C3(0, 230, 255), C3(110, 120, 255)), Rotation = 45 }, logo)
    label(logo, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), Text = "R", Font = F_BLACK, TextSize = 19, TextColor3 = COL.bg })
    label(header, { Position = UDim2.new(0, 58, 0, 10), Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 20), Font = F_BLACK, TextSize = 16, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Text = "RTX ULTRA" })
    label(header, { Position = UDim2.new(0, 58, 0, 30), Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 16), TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = COL.dim, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Text = "v" .. VERSION .. " · Cinematic Engine" })

    local closeBtn = new("TextButton", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 34), Position = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0.5, -17), BackgroundColor3 = COL.card, Text = "×", Font = F_BOLD, TextSize = 22, TextColor3 = COL.text, AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, header)
    corner(closeBtn, 10)
    local masterBtn = new("TextButton", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(96, 30), Position = UDim2.new(1, -152, 0.5, -15), BackgroundColor3 = COL.card, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, header)
    corner(masterBtn, 15); local masterStroke = stroke(masterBtn, COL.good, 1.2, 0.3)
    local masterDot = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8), Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0.5, -4), BackgroundColor3 = COL.good, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, masterBtn)
    corner(masterDot, 4)
    local masterLbl = label(masterBtn, { Position = UDim2.new(0, 26, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 1, 0), Font = F_BOLD, TextSize = 12, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Text = "RTX ON", TextColor3 = COL.good })
    local telem = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(190, 28), Position = UDim2.new(1, -352, 0.5, -14), BackgroundColor3 = COL.card, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, header)
    corner(telem, 14); stroke(telem, COL.border, 1, 0.3)
    local telemLbl = label(telem, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), Font = F_BOLD, TextSize = 10, Text = "-- FPS · -- ms · -- MB", TextColor3 = COL.dim })
    new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 56), BackgroundColor3 = COL.border, BackgroundTransparency = 0.5, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, panel)

    -- sidebar
    local sidebar = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(0, 128, 1, -76), Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 66), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, panel)
    local TAB_H, TAB_GAP = 34, 4
    local tabBg = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, TAB_H), BackgroundColor3 = COL.hover, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, sidebar)
    corner(tabBg, 9)
    local tabBar = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 16), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -8), BackgroundColor3 = COL.accent, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, tabBg)
    corner(tabBar, 2)
    local tabButtons = {}
    for i, t in ipairs(TABS) do
        local b = new("TextButton", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, TAB_H), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, (i - 1) * (TAB_H + TAB_GAP)), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = t.label, Font = F_MED, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = COL.dim, AutoButtonColor = false, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 2 }, sidebar)
        new("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 16) }, b); tabButtons[t.id] = { btn = b, index = i }
    end
    local resetBtn = new("TextButton", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -34), BackgroundColor3 = COL.card, Text = "↺  Reset All", Font = F_MED, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = COL.text, AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, sidebar)
    corner(resetBtn, 9); stroke(resetBtn, COL.border, 1, 0.4); addRipple(resetBtn, gui)
    resetBtn.Activated:Connect(resetAll)

    -- pages
    local fade = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -164, 1, -76), Position = UDim2.new(0, 152, 0, 66), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, panel)
    local holder = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, fade)
    local pages, pageRows = {}, {}
    local function newPage(id, grid)
        local sf = new("ScrollingFrame", { Name = id, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ScrollBarThickness = 3, ScrollBarImageColor3 = COL.accent,
            CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y, Visible = false }, holder)
        new("UIPadding", { PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 30) }, sf)
        if grid then new("UIGridLayout", { CellSize = UDim2.new(0.5, -4, 0, 88), CellPadding = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, sf)
        else new("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, sf) end
        pages[id] = sf; pageRows[id] = {}; return sf
    end

    local function createRow(page, def, order)
        local typ = def.type
        local h = (typ == "tier" or typ == "slider") and 72 or 56
        if typ == "info" then h = def.h or 70 end
        local row = new("CanvasGroup", { LayoutOrder = order, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, h), BackgroundColor3 = COL.card, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, page)
        corner(row, 10); stroke(row, COL.border, 1, 0.3)
        label(row, { Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 8), Size = UDim2.new(1, -120, 0, 18), Font = F_BOLD, TextSize = 14, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Text = def.label, TextColor3 = COL.text })
        label(row, { Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 26), Size = UDim2.new(1, -(typ == "toggle" and 90 or 28), 0, typ == "info" and h - 30 or 14), TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = COL.dim,
            TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, Text = def.desc or "" })
        local cb = function(v) onChanged(def.key, v) end
        if typ == "tier" then
            local c, setter = createSegment(row, Settings[def.key], cb, def.options)
            c.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 40); rowSetters[def.key] = setter
        elseif typ == "toggle" then
            local c, setter = createToggle(row, Settings[def.key], cb)
            c.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5); c.Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0.5, 0); rowSetters[def.key] = setter
        elseif typ == "slider" then
            local vl = label(row, { Position = UDim2.new(1, -114, 0, 8), Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 18), Font = F_BOLD, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = COL.accent, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right })
            local c, setter = createSlider(row, def, Settings[def.key], cb, page, vl)
            c.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 38); rowSetters[def.key] = setter
        elseif typ == "button" then
            local b = new("TextButton", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(92, 32), BackgroundColor3 = def.color or COL.accent, Text = def.btn, Font = F_BOLD, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = COL.bg, AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, row)
            corner(b, 9); addRipple(b, gui); b.Activated:Connect(def.action)
        elseif typ == "slots" then
            local function mk(txt, x, col, fn)
                local b = new("TextButton", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, x, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 32), BackgroundColor3 = col, Text = txt, Font = F_BOLD, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = COL.bg, AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, row)
                corner(b, 9); addRipple(b, gui); b.Activated:Connect(fn)
            end
            mk("Save", -80, COL.accent, function()
                local snap = {}; for k in pairs(DEFAULTS) do snap[k] = Settings[k] end
                store.slots[tostring(def.slot)] = snap; flushSave(); toast("Saved to profile " .. def.slot)
            end)
            mk("Load", -14, COL.good, function()
                local s = store.slots[tostring(def.slot)]
                if s then applyTable(s); toast("Loaded profile " .. def.slot) else toast("Profile " .. def.slot .. " is empty") end
            end)
        end
        local rows = pageRows[page.Name]; rows[#rows + 1] = row
        return row
    end

    local function playRows(id)
        for i, r in ipairs(pageRows[id] or {}) do
            r.GroupTransparency = 1
            task.delay((i - 1) * 0.035, function() if running and r.Parent then tween(r, { GroupTransparency = 0 }, 0.3) end end)
        end
    end

    -- presets page
    local presetPage = newPage("presets", true)
    local presetCards = {}
    for i, p in ipairs(PRESETS) do
        local card = new("TextButton", { LayoutOrder = i, BackgroundColor3 = COL.card, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, presetPage)
        corner(card, 12); local cs = stroke(card, COL.border, 1.5, 0.3); addRipple(card, gui)
        local strip = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 4), Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 12), BackgroundColor3 = p.accent, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, card)
        corner(strip, 2)
        label(card, { Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 22), Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 22), Font = F_BOLD, TextSize = 15, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Text = p.id, TextColor3 = COL.text })
        label(card, { Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 44), Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 38), TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = COL.dim, TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, Text = p.desc })
        local active = label(card, { Position = UDim2.new(1, -74, 0, 8), Size = UDim2.new(0, 62, 0, 16), Font = F_BOLD, TextSize = 9, TextColor3 = p.accent, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, Text = "● ACTIVE", TextTransparency = 1 })
        card.Activated:Connect(function() applyPreset(p) end)
        presetCards[i] = { preset = p, stroke = cs, active = active }
    end
    refreshPresets = function()
        for _, c in ipairs(presetCards) do
            local match = true
            for k, v in pairs(c.preset.values) do if Settings[k] ~= v then match = false; break end end
            tween(c.stroke, { Color = match and c.preset.accent or COL.border, Transparency = match and 0 or 0.3 }, 0.2)
            tween(c.active, { TextTransparency = match and 0 or 1 }, 0.2)
        end
    end

    -- settings pages
    local function stopAll() if env.__RTX_V9 then env.__RTX_V9.Stop() end end
    local SYSTEM = {
        { type = "slots", label = "Profile 1", desc = "Save or load a full setup", slot = 1 },
        { type = "slots", label = "Profile 2", desc = "Save or load a full setup", slot = 2 },
        { type = "slots", label = "Profile 3", desc = "Save or load a full setup", slot = 3 },
        { type = "button", label = "Screenshot Mode", desc = "Hides the UI for 6 seconds", btn = "Hide 6s", action = function() ctl.hideUI(6) end },
        { type = "button", label = "Stop Script", desc = "Remove every effect and restore the game", btn = "Stop", color = COL.bad, action = stopAll },
        { type = "info", label = "Info", h = 84, desc = (canFile and "Settings auto-save to " .. CFG.SAVE_FILE or "Your executor has no file access: settings will not be saved.") ..
            "\nPC keys: RightShift = panel, RightCtrl = RTX on/off.\nMobile: tap the RTX badge (drag it to move)." },
    }
    for _, t in ipairs(TABS) do
        if t.id ~= "presets" then
            local page = newPage(t.id, false)
            local defs = t.id == "system" and SYSTEM or SETTINGS_TREE[t.id]
            for i, def in ipairs(defs) do createRow(page, def, i) end
        end
    end
    refreshPresets()

    local currentTab
    local function switchTab(id, instant)
        if currentTab == id then return end
        local first = currentTab == nil; currentTab = id
        for tid, info in pairs(tabButtons) do tween(info.btn, { TextColor3 = (tid == id) and COL.text or COL.dim }, 0.18) end
        tween(tabBg, { Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, (tabButtons[id].index - 1) * (TAB_H + TAB_GAP)) }, 0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
        for tid, pg in pairs(pages) do pg.Visible = (tid == id) end
        holder.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, first and 0 or 14)
        tween(holder, { Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0) }, 0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
        if not instant then playRows(id) end
    end
    for id, info in pairs(tabButtons) do
        addRipple(info.btn, gui)
        info.btn.Activated:Connect(function() switchTab(id) end)
    end

    -- toast
    local toastFrame = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(250, 34), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 70, 1, -12), BackgroundColor3 = COL.card, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 20 }, panel)
    corner(toastFrame, 17); local toastStroke = stroke(toastFrame, COL.accent, 1, 1)
    local toastLbl = label(toastFrame, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), Font = F_MED, TextSize = 12, TextTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 21, TextColor3 = COL.text })
    local toastToken = 0
    toast = function(text)
        toastToken += 1; local my = toastToken; toastLbl.Text = text; toastFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 70, 1, -2)
        tween(toastFrame, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.05, Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 70, 1, -12) }, 0.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
        tween(toastStroke, { Transparency = 0.3 }, 0.2); tween(toastLbl, { TextTransparency = 0 }, 0.2)
        task.delay(2.2, function()
            if my ~= toastToken or not running then return end
            tween(toastFrame, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.3); tween(toastStroke, { Transparency = 1 }, 0.3); tween(toastLbl, { TextTransparency = 1 }, 0.3)
        end)
    end

    onMasterChanged = function(on)
        masterLbl.Text = on and "RTX ON" or "RTX OFF"
        tween(masterLbl, { TextColor3 = on and COL.good or COL.bad }, 0.2)
        tween(masterDot, { BackgroundColor3 = on and COL.good or COL.bad }, 0.2)
        tween(masterStroke, { Color = on and COL.good or COL.bad }, 0.2)
        toast(on and "RTX Enabled" or "RTX Disabled")
    end
    addRipple(masterBtn, gui); masterBtn.Activated:Connect(function() setMaster(not state.enabled) end)

    -- open / close
    local function openPanel()
        if uiOpen then return end; uiOpen = true; mover.Visible = true; refit()
        panel.GroupTransparency = 1; fit.Scale = fitTarget * 0.9; panel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 24)
        tween(panel, { GroupTransparency = 0, Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0) }, 0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
        tween(fit, { Scale = fitTarget }, 0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
        playRows(currentTab or "presets")
    end
    local function closePanel()
        if not uiOpen then return end; uiOpen = false
        tween(panel, { GroupTransparency = 1 }, 0.2); tween(fit, { Scale = fitTarget * 0.94 }, 0.2)
        task.delay(0.22, function() if not uiOpen and running then mover.Visible = false end end)
    end
    local function togglePanel() if uiOpen then closePanel() else openPanel() end end
    ctl.toggle = togglePanel
    ctl.hideUI = function(sec)
        local was = uiOpen; closePanel(); badge.Visible = false; overlayGui.Enabled = false
        task.delay(sec, function()
            if not running then return end
            badge.Visible = true; overlayGui.Enabled = true; if was then openPanel() end
        end)
    end
    closeBtn.Activated:Connect(closePanel)

    -- badge: tap to toggle, drag to move
    badge.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if not isPointer(input) then return end
        local startPos, startU = input.Position, badge.Position; local moved = false
        tween(badge, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(48, 48) }, 0.1)
        beginDrag(function(pos)
            local d = pos - startPos; if d.Magnitude > 8 then moved = true end
            if moved then badge.Position = UDim2.new(startU.X.Scale, startU.X.Offset + d.X, startU.Y.Scale, startU.Y.Offset + d.Y) end
        end, function()
            tween(badge, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(54, 54) }, 0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
            if not moved then togglePanel() end
        end)
    end)

    -- drag panel by header
    header.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if not isPointer(input) then return end
        local startPos, startU = input.Position, mover.Position
        beginDrag(function(pos)
            local d = pos - startPos
            mover.Position = UDim2.new(startU.X.Scale, startU.X.Offset + d.X, startU.Y.Scale, startU.Y.Offset + d.Y)
        end, nil)
    end)

    -- badge pulse + telemetry
    task.spawn(function()
        while running and gui.Parent do
            local ping = 0; pcall(function() ping = math.floor(Stats.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue()) end)
            local mem = 0; pcall(function() mem = math.floor(Stats:GetTotalMemoryUsageMb()) end)
            local f = math.floor(S.fps + 0.5)
            telemLbl.Text = string.format("%d FPS · %d ms · %d MB", f, ping, mem)
            telemLbl.TextColor3 = f >= 45 and COL.good or (f >= 25 and COL.dim or COL.bad)
            badgeStroke.Transparency = 0.15 + (math.sin(os.clock() * 2.2) * 0.5 + 0.5) * 0.45
            task.wait(0.25)
        end
    end)

    connect(UserInputService.InputBegan, function(input, gp)
        if gp then return end
        if input.KeyCode == CFG.TOGGLE_KEY then togglePanel()
        elseif input.KeyCode == CFG.MASTER_KEY then setMaster(not state.enabled) end
    end)

    switchTab("presets", true)
end

-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
--  MAIN LOOP
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local tRay, tWater, tLights, tBase, tGov, tIgnore, tNeon = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
baseSetup(); applyDiscrete(); refreshIgnore(); sampleWorld(true)
S.indoor, S.sunF, S.sunDisk = S.indoorT, S.sunFT, S.sunDiskT; S.focus, S.water = S.focusT, S.waterT
local startW = WEATHER[Settings.weather] or WEATHER.Clear
for k, v in pairs(startW) do wx[k] = v end
scanNeonBleed(); updateLights(); updateBars()

local function step(dt)
    dt = math.min(dt, 0.1); S.fps = lerp(S.fps, 1 / math.max(dt, 1e-4), 0.05)
    if dirtyAt and os.clock() - dirtyAt > 1.5 then flushSave() end
    if not state.enabled then return end
    tRay += dt; tWater += dt; tLights += dt; tBase += dt; tGov += dt; tIgnore += dt; tNeon += dt
    if tIgnore >= 1.0 then tIgnore = 0; refreshIgnore() end
    if tRay >= 0.075 then tRay = 0; local dw = tWater >= 0.25; if dw then tWater = 0 end; sampleWorld(dw) end
    if tLights >= CFG.LIGHT_REFRESH then tLights = 0; updateLights() end
    if tNeon >= CFG.NEON_SCAN_INTERVAL then tNeon = 0; scanNeonBleed() end
    if tBase >= 3.0 then tBase = 0; baseSetup() end
    if Settings.adaptive and tGov >= 3.0 then
        tGov = 0; local base = SHADOW_COUNT[Settings.shadows] or 48
        if S.fps < CFG.FPS_LOW then S.shadowLimit = math.max(math.floor(base * 0.35), S.shadowLimit - 8); S.dofOn = false
        elseif S.fps > CFG.FPS_HIGH then S.shadowLimit = math.min(base, S.shadowLimit + 6); S.dofOn = Settings.dof ~= "Off" end
    end
    apply(dt)
end

local lastErr
connect(RunService.Heartbeat, function(dt)
    local ok, err = pcall(step, dt)
    if not ok and err ~= lastErr then lastErr = err; warn("[RTX V9] " .. tostring(err)) end
end)

local okUI, errUI = pcall(buildUI)
if not okUI then warn("[RTX V9] UI failed: " .. tostring(errUI)) end

env.__RTX_V9 = {
    Version = VERSION, Settings = Settings, State = S, Config = CFG, SetEnabled = setMaster,
    Stop = function()
        if not running then return end
        running = false
        if dirtyAt then flushSave() end
        for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
        restoreGameFx(); restoreWorld()
        pcall(function() if origTechnology ~= Lighting.Technology then Lighting.Technology = origTechnology end end)
        for _, i in ipairs(created) do pcall(function() i:Destroy() end) end
        for _, fn in ipairs(restores) do pcall(fn) end
        print("[RTX V9] stopped.")
    end,
}

pcall(function()
    StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", { Title = "RTX Nexus V9", Text = IS_TOUCH and "Tap the RTX badge to open." or "RightShift to open.", Duration = 6 })
end)

scripts.code:
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
    Name = "Prison Life | Made by MR.Balls",
    LoadingTitle = "Prison Life",
    LoadingSubtitle = "Made by MR.Balls",
    ConfigurationSaving = {
        Enabled = true,
        FolderName = "MRBallsPrisonLife",
        FileName = "Config"
    },
    KeySystem = false
})

local CombatTab = Window:CreateTab("Combat", 4483362458)
local VisualsTab = Window:CreateTab("Visuals", 4483362458)
local MovementTab = Window:CreateTab("Movement", 4483362458)
local MiscTab = Window:CreateTab("Misc", 4483362458)

-- ========== FLAGS ==========
local Flags = {
    Aimbot = false,
    AimbotTeamCheck = true,
    AimbotWallCheck = true,
    AimbotFOV = 140,
    AimbotSmooth = 0.16,
    AimbotPart = "Head",
    ShowFOV = true,
    ESP = false,
    ESPName = true,
    ESPDistance = true,
    ESPChams = true,
    ESPTeamCheck = true,
    WalkSpeed = 16,
    JumpPower = 50,
    InfJump = false,
    Fly = false,
    FlySpeed = 55,
    Noclip = false,
    HitboxExpander = false,
    HitboxSize = 5,
    Fullbright = false,
}

local Aiming = false
local ButtonUnlocked = false -- true = can move the button
local TapCount = 0
local LastTap = 0

-- ========== AIM BUTTON ==========
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "MRBallsAimGui"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.Parent = game.CoreGui

local AimButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
AimButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 115, 0, 115)
AimButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -135, 0.62, 0)
AimButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
AimButton.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
AimButton.Text = "AIM"
AimButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
AimButton.TextSize = 24
AimButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
AimButton.Parent = ScreenGui

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
corner.Parent = AimButton

local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
stroke.Thickness = 2
stroke.Parent = AimButton

-- Dragging variables
local dragging = false
local dragStart, startPos

local function onInputBegan(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        -- 4 tap unlock system
        local now = tick()
        if now - LastTap < 0.45 then
            TapCount = TapCount + 1
        else
            TapCount = 1
        end
        LastTap = now

        if TapCount >= 4 then
            ButtonUnlocked = not ButtonUnlocked
            TapCount = 0
            if ButtonUnlocked then
                AimButton.Text = "MOVE"
                stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100)
                Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Button", Content = "Unlocked - You can move it now", Duration = 3})
            else
                AimButton.Text = "AIM"
                stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
                Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Button", Content = "Locked in place", Duration = 3})
            end
            return
        end

        -- Normal aim hold
        if not ButtonUnlocked then
            Aiming = true
            AimButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 30, 30)
            AimButton.Text = "LOCK"
        else
            -- Start dragging
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = AimButton.Position
        end
    end
end

local function onInputEnded(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        Aiming = false
        dragging = false
        if not ButtonUnlocked then
            AimButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
            AimButton.Text = "AIM"
        end
    end
end

AimButton.InputBegan:Connect(onInputBegan)
AimButton.InputEnded:Connect(onInputEnded)

UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and ButtonUnlocked and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        AimButton.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPos.X.Scale,
            startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPos.Y.Scale,
            startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

-- ========== COMBAT ==========
CombatTab:CreateSection("Aimbot")

CombatTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Aimbot",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Flag = "Aimbot",
    Callback = function(v) Flags.Aimbot = v end
})

CombatTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Show FOV Circle",
    CurrentValue = true,
    Flag = "ShowFOV",
    Callback = function(v) Flags.ShowFOV = v end
})

CombatTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Team Check",
    CurrentValue = true,
    Flag = "AimTeam",
    Callback = function(v) Flags.AimbotTeamCheck = v end
})

CombatTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Wall Check",
    CurrentValue = true,
    Flag = "AimWall",
    Callback = function(v) Flags.AimbotWallCheck = v end
})

CombatTab:CreateSlider({
    Name = "Aimbot FOV",
    Range = {50, 350},
    Increment = 5,
    CurrentValue = 140,
    Flag = "AimFOV",
    Callback = function(v) Flags.AimbotFOV = v end
})

CombatTab:CreateSlider({
    Name = "Smoothness (0 = Instant)",
    Range = {0, 1},
    Increment = 0.01,
    CurrentValue = 0.16,
    Flag = "AimSmooth",
    Callback = function(v) Flags.AimbotSmooth = v end
})

CombatTab:CreateDropdown({
    Name = "Aim Part",
    Options = {"Head", "HumanoidRootPart", "Torso", "UpperTorso"},
    CurrentOption = "Head",
    Flag = "AimPart",
    Callback = function(v) Flags.AimbotPart = v end
})

CombatTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Hitbox Expander",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Flag = "Hitbox",
    Callback = function(v) Flags.HitboxExpander = v end
})

CombatTab:CreateSlider({
    Name = "Hitbox Size",
    Range = {2, 15},
    Increment = 0.5,
    CurrentValue = 5,
    Flag = "HitSize",
    Callback = function(v) Flags.HitboxSize = v end
})

-- ========== VISUALS ==========
VisualsTab:CreateToggle({Name = "ESP", CurrentValue = false, Flag = "ESP", Callback = function(v) Flags.ESP = v end})
VisualsTab:CreateToggle({Name = "Name ESP", CurrentValue = true, Flag = "ESPName", Callback = function(v) Flags.ESPName = v end})
VisualsTab:CreateToggle({Name = "Distance ESP", CurrentValue = true, Flag = "ESPDist", Callback = function(v) Flags.ESPDistance = v end})
VisualsTab:CreateToggle({Name = "Chams", CurrentValue = true, Flag = "ESPChams", Callback = function(v) Flags.ESPChams = v end})
VisualsTab:CreateToggle({Name = "Team Check", CurrentValue = true, Flag = "ESPTeam", Callback = function(v) Flags.ESPTeamCheck = v end})
VisualsTab:CreateToggle({Name = "Fullbright", CurrentValue = false, Flag = "Fullbright", Callback = function(v)
    Flags.Fullbright = v
    if v then
        Lighting.Brightness = 2
        Lighting.ClockTime = 14
        Lighting.FogEnd = 100000
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
    end
end})

-- ========== MOVEMENT ==========
MovementTab:CreateSlider({Name = "WalkSpeed", Range = {16, 120}, Increment = 1, CurrentValue = 16, Flag = "Speed", Callback = function(v)
    Flags.WalkSpeed = v
    local hum = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then hum.WalkSpeed = v end
end})

MovementTab:CreateSlider({Name = "JumpPower", Range = {50, 150}, Increment = 1, CurrentValue = 50, Flag = "Jump", Callback = function(v)
    Flags.JumpPower = v
    local hum = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then hum.JumpPower = v end
end})

MovementTab:CreateToggle({Name = "Infinite Jump", CurrentValue = false, Flag = "InfJump", Callback = function(v) Flags.InfJump = v end})
MovementTab:CreateToggle({Name = "Fly", CurrentValue = false, Flag = "Fly", Callback = function(v) Flags.Fly = v end})
MovementTab:CreateSlider({Name = "Fly Speed", Range = {20, 120}, Increment = 5, CurrentValue = 55, Flag = "FlySpeed", Callback = function(v) Flags.FlySpeed = v end})
MovementTab:CreateToggle({Name = "Noclip", CurrentValue = false, Flag = "Noclip", Callback = function(v) Flags.Noclip = v end})

-- ========== MISC ==========
MiscTab:CreateButton({Name = "Unlock FPS", Callback = function() setfpscap(999) end})
MiscTab:CreateButton({Name = "Rejoin", Callback = function()
    game:GetService("TeleportService"):Teleport(game.PlaceId, LocalPlayer)
end})

-- ========== FOV CIRCLE ==========
local FOVCircle = Drawing.new("Circle")
FOVCircle.Thickness = 2
FOVCircle.NumSides = 64
FOVCircle.Filled = false
FOVCircle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70)
FOVCircle.Visibility = false
FOVCircle.ZIndex = 999

-- ========== AIMBOT ==========
local function isVisible(part)
    if not Flags.AimbotWallCheck then return true end
    local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local ray = Ray.new(origin, part.Position - origin)
    local hit = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(ray, {LocalPlayer.Character, part.Parent})
    return hit == nil or hit:IsDescendantOf(part.Parent)
end

local function getClosest()
    local closest = nil
    local shortest = Flags.AimbotFOV
    local center = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X/2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y/2)

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character then
            if Flags.AimbotTeamCheck and player.Team and LocalPlayer.Team and player.Team == LocalPlayer.Team then
                continue
            end

            local char = player.Character
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local part = char:FindFirstChild(Flags.AimbotPart) or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")

            if hum and hum.Health > 0 and part then
                local pos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                if onScreen then
                    local dist = (Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y) - center).Magnitude
                    if dist < shortest and isVisible(part) then
                        shortest = dist
                        closest = part
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return closest
end

-- ========== MAIN LOOP ==========
local ESPFolder = Instance.new("Folder", game.CoreGui)
ESPFolder.Name = "MRBallsESP"

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    -- FOV Circle (always update)
    FOVCircle.Position = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X/2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y/2)
    FOVCircle.Radius = Flags.AimbotFOV
    FOVCircle.Visibility = Flags.ShowFOV and Flags.Aimbot

    -- Aimbot
    if Flags.Aimbot and Aiming and not ButtonUnlocked then
        local target = getClosest()
        if target then
            local newCF = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, target.Position)
            if Flags.AimbotSmooth <= 0 then
                Camera.CFrame = newCF
            else
                Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame:Lerp(newCF, 1 - Flags.AimbotSmooth)
            end
        end
    end

    -- ESP
    ESPFolder:ClearAllChildren()
    if Flags.ESP then
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character then
                if not (Flags.ESPTeamCheck and player.Team and LocalPlayer.Team and player.Team == LocalPlayer.Team) then
                    local char = player.Character
                    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
                    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")

                    if root and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                        if Flags.ESPChams then
                            local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
                            hl.Adornee = char
                            hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 40)
                            hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                            hl.FillTransparency = 0.55
                            hl.Parent = ESPFolder
                        end

                        if Flags.ESPName or Flags.ESPDistance then
                            local bill = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
                            bill.Adornee = head or root
                            bill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 40)
                            bill.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
                            bill.AlwaysOnTop = true
                            bill.Parent = ESPFolder

                            local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                            label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
                            label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                            label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                            label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
                            label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                            label.TextSize = 13
                            label.Parent = bill

                            local dist = (Camera.CFrame.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
                            local text = Flags.ESPName and player.Name or ""
                            if Flags.ESPDistance then
                                text = text .. string.format(" [%.0fm]", dist)
                            end
                            label.Text = text
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Movement
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then
        if Flags.WalkSpeed ~= 16 then hum.WalkSpeed = Flags.WalkSpeed end
        if Flags.JumpPower ~= 50 then hum.JumpPower = Flags.JumpPower end
    end

    if Flags.Noclip and char then
        for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.CanCollide = false end
        end
    end

    if Flags.HitboxExpander then
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character then
                local root = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or player.Character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
                if root then
                    root.Size = Vector3.new(Flags.HitboxSize, Flags.HitboxSize, Flags.HitboxSize)
                    root.Transparency = 0.6
                    root.CanCollide = false
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

UIS.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
    if Flags.InfJump and LocalPlayer.Character then
        local hum = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping) end
    end
end)

Rayfield:Notify({
    Title = "Prison Life",
    Content = "Tap AIM 4x to move button | FOV visible | Made by MR.Balls",
    Duration = 6
})

print("Prison Life | FOV + Movable Button | Made by MR.Balls")
