local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local VirtualInputManager = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local mouse = player:GetMouse()
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local enabled = false
local autoLock = false
local triggerBot = false
local lockPartName = "Head"
local aimKey = Enum.KeyCode.Q
local fovRadius = 1000
local shotDelay = 0.08
local lastShot = 0
local triggerDisabledByT = false
local triggerEnableDelay = 0.04
local triggerEnableTime = 0
local lockedPart
local currentHighlight
local highlightTween

local Whitelist = {}
local function isWhitelisted(plr)
	return plr and Whitelist[plr.Name] == true
end
local whitelistHighlights = {}
local function applyWhitelistHighlight(plr)
	if not plr or not plr.Character then return end
	if whitelistHighlights[plr] then return end
	local h = Instance.new("Highlight")
	h.Name = "_WhitelistHL"
	h.Adornee = plr.Character
	h.FillTransparency = 1
	h.OutlineTransparency = 0
	h.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(0,170,255)
	h.Parent = plr.Character
	whitelistHighlights[plr] = h
end
local function removeWhitelistHighlight(plr)
	if whitelistHighlights[plr] then
		whitelistHighlights[plr]:Destroy()
		whitelistHighlights[plr] = nil
	end
end
local function updateWhitelistForPlayer(plr)
	if isWhitelisted(plr) then
		applyWhitelistHighlight(plr)
	else
		removeWhitelistHighlight(plr)
	end
end

local function clearHighlight()
	if highlightTween then
		highlightTween:Cancel()
		highlightTween = nil
	end
	if currentHighlight then
		currentHighlight:Destroy()
		currentHighlight = nil
	end
end

local LOSParams = RaycastParams.new()
LOSParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist
LOSParams.IgnoreWater = true
local function updateLOSFilter()
	if player.Character then
		LOSParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { player.Character, workspace.Terrain }
	end
end
updateLOSFilter()
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	task.wait(0.2)
	updateLOSFilter()
end)

local function isTargetUnderLocalPlayer(char)
	local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
	local myChar = player.Character
	if not myChar then return false end
	local myRoot = myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not head or not myRoot then return false end
	return head.Position.Y < myRoot.Position.Y
end

local weapons = {
	{display = "MP5", keywords = {"mp5", "smg"}, color = Color3.new(1,1,0)},
	{display = "Mossberg", keywords = {"mossberg", "shotgun"}, color = Color3.new(1,0,1)},
	{display = "P9", keywords = {"p9", "pistol", "p-9", "9mm"}, color = Color3.new(0,1,1)},
	{display = "Nambu", keywords = {"nambu", "type14", "type 14", "nambu type"}, color = Color3.new(1,0.5,0)},
	{display = "Howa", keywords = {"howa", "rifle"}, color = Color3.new(1,0.5,0)},
}
local mapESPEnabled = true
local playerESPEnabled = true
local espToggles = {}
local billboards = {}
local lastAddedTime = 0
local addedDebounce = 0.1
for _, w in ipairs(weapons) do
	espToggles[w.display] = true
end
local MAX_BILLBOARDS = 300
local function isShopItem(obj)
	local p = obj.Parent
	while p do
		local n = p.Name:lower()
		if n:find("shop") or n:find("vendor") or n:find("store") or n:find("display") or
		   n:find("case") or n:find("locker") or n:find("shelf") or n:find("rack") or
		   n:find("showcase") or n:find("cabinet") then
			return true
		end
		p = p.Parent
	end
	return false
end
local function getBestPart(obj)
	if obj.PrimaryPart then return obj.PrimaryPart end
	return obj:FindFirstChild("Handle") or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
end
local function createBillboard(item, name, color)
	if not item:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then return end
	if isShopItem(item) then return end
	if #billboards >= MAX_BILLBOARDS then return end
	local part = getBestPart(item)
	if not part then return end
	local existing = item:FindFirstChild("ItemESP")
	if existing then existing:Destroy() end
	local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	bb.Name = "ItemESP"
	bb.Adornee = part
	bb.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 60)
	bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 0)
	bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
	bb.MaxDistance = 15000
	bb.Parent = item
	local nameLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	nameLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0.6,0)
	nameLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
	nameLbl.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0,0,0)
	nameLbl.Text = name
	nameLbl.TextColor3 = color
	nameLbl.TextScaled = true
	nameLbl.Font = Enum.Font.Oswald
	nameLbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.6
	nameLbl.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0,0,0)
	nameLbl.Parent = bb
	Instance.new("UICorner", nameLbl).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,6)
	local distLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	distLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0.4,0)
	distLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0.6,0)
	distLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	distLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
	distLbl.TextScaled = true
	distLbl.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	distLbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5
	distLbl.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0,0,0)
	distLbl.Parent = bb
	billboards[item] = {bb = bb, dist = distLbl, part = part, enabled = espToggles[name] and true}
	bb.Enabled = billboards[item].enabled
end
local function tryTag(obj)
	if not (obj:IsA("Tool") or obj:IsA("Model")) then return end
	if isShopItem(obj) then return end
	local n = obj.Name:lower()
	for _, w in ipairs(weapons) do
		for _, kw in ipairs(w.keywords) do
			if n:find(kw, 1, true) then
				createBillboard(obj, w.display, w.color)
				return
			end
		end
	end
end
local function instantGunCheck()
	if not playerESPEnabled then return end
	for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local char = plr.Character
		if char then
			for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
				tryTag(child)
			end
		end
		local bp = plr:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
		if bp then
			for _, child in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do
				tryTag(child)
			end
		end
	end
end
Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(child)
	local t = tick()
	if t - lastAddedTime < addedDebounce then return end
	lastAddedTime = t
	tryTag(child)
	if child:IsA("Model") or child:IsA("Folder") or child:IsA("Tool") then
		for _, sub in ipairs(child:GetDescendants()) do
			tryTag(sub)
		end
	end
	instantGunCheck()
end)
Workspace.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(obj)
	billboards[obj] = nil
end)
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	local hrp = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then return end
	for item, data in pairs(billboards) do
		if not item.Parent or not data.part.Parent or not data.bb.Parent then
			billboards[item] = nil
			continue
		end
		if data.enabled then
			local studs = math.floor((hrp.Position - data.part.Position).Magnitude)
			data.dist.Text = studs .. " studs"
			data.dist.TextColor3 = studs < 300 and Color3.new(0,1,0) or studs < 1000 and Color3.new(1,1,0) or Color3.new(1,0.3,0.3)
		end
	end
end)
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		if playerESPEnabled then
			instantGunCheck()
		end

local function isTargetValid(part)
	if not part or not part.Parent then return false end
	local plr = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(part.Parent)
	if isWhitelisted(plr) then return false end
	local hum = part.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
	return hum and hum.Health > 0
end
local function getClosestTarget()
	local closest
	local shortest = fovRadius
	for _,plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if plr ~= player and plr.Character and not isWhitelisted(plr) then
			local char = plr.Character
			local hum = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
			if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
				local effectivePartName = lockPartName
				if lockPartName == "Head" then
					if isTargetUnderLocalPlayer(char) then
						effectivePartName = "HumanoidRootPart"
					end
				end
				local part = char:FindFirstChild(effectivePartName)
				if part then
					local pos,onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
					if onScreen then
						local dist = (Vector2.new(pos.X,pos.Y) - Vector2.new(mouse.X,mouse.Y)).Magnitude
						if dist < shortest then
							shortest = dist
							closest = part
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return closest
end
local function hasLineOfSight(targetPart)
	if not targetPart then return false end
	local origin = camera.CFrame.Position
	local direction = targetPart.Position - origin
	local r = workspace:Raycast(origin,direction,LOSParams)
	if not r then return true end
	return r.Instance and r.Instance:IsDescendantOf(targetPart.Parent)
end

local function applyHighlight(char)
	clearHighlight()
	local h = Instance.new("Highlight")
	h.Adornee = char
	h.FillTransparency = 1
	h.OutlineTransparency = 0
	h.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(170,0,255)
	h.Parent = char
	currentHighlight = h
	highlightTween = TweenService:Create( h, TweenInfo.new(0.7,Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,Enum.EasingDirection.InOut,-1,true), {OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)} )
	highlightTween:Play()
end

local function tryTrigger()
	if triggerDisabledByT then return end
	if os.clock() < triggerEnableTime then return end
	if not triggerBot then return end
	if not lockedPart then return end
	if not isTargetValid(lockedPart) then return end
	if not hasLineOfSight(lockedPart) then return end
	if os.clock() - lastShot < shotDelay then return end
	lastShot = os.clock()
	if mouse1click then
		mouse1click()
	else
		VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(0,0,0,true,game,0)
		task.wait()
		VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(0,0,0,false,game,0)
	end
end

	if not enabled then

		if autoLock then

			if isUnder and lockedPart == head then
				lockedPart = root
			elseif not isUnder and lockedPart == root then
				lockedPart = head
			end
		end
	end
	if char and (not currentHighlight or currentHighlight.Adornee ~= char) then
		applyHighlight(char)
	end
	camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(camera.CFrame.Position, lockedPart.Position)
	tryTrigger()

local me = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local root = me.Character and me.Character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
if root then root.Anchored = true end
local offset = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
local origin = CFrame.new()
local tool
for _,v in ipairs(me:GetDescendants()) do if v.Name == 'SyncAPI' then tool = v.Parent break end end
if not tool then for _,v in ipairs(game.ReplicatedStorage:GetDescendants()) do if v.Name == 'SyncAPI' then tool = v.Parent break end end end
if not tool then warn('yo ur not have f3x') return end
local syncApi = tool:FindFirstChild('SyncAPI')
local remote = syncApi and syncApi:FindFirstChild('ServerEndpoint')
if not remote then warn('no server endpoint found') return end
local function _(args)
    if not remote then return end
    if remote:IsA('RemoteEvent') then
        pcall(remote.FireServer, remote, unpack(args))
    else
        task.spawn(pcall, remote.InvokeServer, remote, unpack(args))
end
end
function CreatePart(partType, cf, parent)
    if not remote then return nil end
    local worldCF = (origin + offset) * cf
    local success, part = pcall(function() return remote:InvokeServer('CreatePart', partType, worldCF, parent) end)
    return success and part or nil
end
function MovePart(part, cf) if not part then return end local worldCF = (origin + offset) * cf _({'SyncMove', {{['Part'] = part, ['CFrame'] = worldCF}}}) end
function Resize(part, size, cf) if not part then return end local worldCF = (origin + offset) * cf _({'SyncResize', {{['Part'] = part, ['CFrame'] = worldCF, ['Size'] = size}}}) end
function SetTrans(part, int) if not part then return end _({'SyncMaterial', {{['Part'] = part, ['Transparency'] = int}}}) end
function Setmate(part, int) if not part then return end _({'SyncMaterial', {{['Part'] = part, ['Material'] = int}}}) end
function Color(part, color) if not part then return end _({'SyncColor', {{['Part'] = part, ['Color'] = color, ['UnionColoring'] = false}}}) end
function SetAnchor(boolean, part) if not part then return end _({'SyncAnchor', {{['Part'] = part, ['Anchored'] = boolean}}}) end
function SetCollision(part, boolean) if not part then return end _({'SyncCollision', {{['Part'] = part, ['CanCollide'] = boolean}}}) end
function AddMesh(part) if not part then return end _({'CreateMeshes', {{['Part'] = part}}}) end
function SetMesh(part, meshid) if not part then return end _({'SyncMesh', {{['Part'] = part, ['MeshId'] = 'rbxassetid://' .. meshid}}}) end
function SpawnDecal(part, side) if not part then return end _({'CreateTextures', {{['Part'] = part, ['Face'] = side, ['TextureType'] = 'Decal'}}}) end
function AddDecal(part, asset, side) if not part then return end _({'SyncTexture', {{['Part'] = part, ['Face'] = side, ['TextureType'] = 'Decal', ['Texture'] = 'rbxassetid://' .. asset}}}) end
function MeshResize(part, size) if not part then return end _({'SyncMesh', {{['Part'] = part, ['Scale'] = size}}}) end
function SetName(part, stringg) if not part then return end _({'SetName', {part}, stringg}) end
function vect(part, of) if not part then return end _({'SyncMesh', {{['Part'] = part, ['Offset'] = of}}}) end
function reflect(part, int) if not part then return end _({'SyncMaterial', {{['Part'] = part, ['Reflectance'] = int}}}) end
function SetMeshtype(part, type) if not part then return end _({'SyncMesh', {{['Part'] = part, ['MeshType'] = type}}}) end
local generatedParts = {}
task.wait(0.1)
local partsToDelete = {}
for _, v in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
    if v:IsA('BasePart') and v.Name ~= 'Terrain' then
        local isPlrPart = false
        for _, p in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p.Character and v:IsDescendantOf(p.Character) then
                isPlrPart = true
                break
            end
        end
        if not isPlrPart then
            table.insert(partsToDelete, v)
        end
    end
end
if #partsToDelete > 0 then
    pcall(function() _({'Remove', partsToDelete}) end)
end
task.wait(0.5)
function SetupPart(idx, partType, cf, size, name, color, mat, trans, refl, coll, anch)
    generatedParts[idx] = CreatePart(partType, cf, workspace)
    Resize(generatedParts[idx], size, cf)
    SetName(generatedParts[idx], name)
    Color(generatedParts[idx], color)
    Setmate(generatedParts[idx], mat)
    SetTrans(generatedParts[idx], trans)
    reflect(generatedParts[idx], refl)
    SetCollision(generatedParts[idx], coll)
    SetAnchor(anch, generatedParts[idx])
end

scripts.code:
-- FPS Changer GUI Script (with Bottom Notification Banner)
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- Remove existing GUI if already running
if CoreGui:FindFirstChild("FPSChangerGUI") then
    CoreGui.FPSChangerGUI:Destroy()
end

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "FPSChangerGUI"

-- Main Window
local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")

-- Bottom Notification Banner
local NotifFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
NotifFrame.Name = "Notification"

local NotifTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")

NotifTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
NotifTitle.Text = "FPS Changer Notice"
NotifTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
NotifTitle.TextSize = 14
NotifTitle.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
NotifTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
NotifTitle.Parent = NotifFrame

local NotifText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
NotifText.Size = UDim2.new(1, -15, 0, 25)
NotifText.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 24)
NotifText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
NotifText.Text = "Your phone must support 90 or 120 Hz for this to work."
NotifText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 235)
NotifText.TextSize = 13
NotifText.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
NotifText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
NotifText.TextWrapped = true
NotifText.Parent = NotifFrame

-- Animate Notification In and Out
task.spawn(function()
    local slideIn = TweenService:Create(NotifFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -140, 1, -75)
    })
    slideIn:Play()
    slideIn.Completed:Wait()
    
    task.wait(5) -- Stays visible for 5 seconds
    
    local slideOut = TweenService:Create(NotifFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -140, 1, 10)
    })
    slideOut:Play()
    slideOut.Completed:Wait()
    NotifFrame:Destroy()
end)

-- Set default 120 FPS immediately on startup
pcall(function()
    setfflag("TaskSchedulerTargetFps", "120")
end)

-- Apply custom FPS
ApplyButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local targetFps = TextBox.Text
    pcall(function()
        setfflag("TaskSchedulerTargetFps", tostring(targetFps))
    end)
end)

-- Minimize / Expand Logic
local minimized = false
MinButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    minimized = not minimized
    if minimized then
        MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 30)
        MinButton.Text = "+"
    else
        MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 140)
        MinButton.Text = "-"
    end
end)

-- Keybind Toggle (RightShift)
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if not gameProcessed and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
        MainFrame.Visible = not MainFrame.Visible
    end
end)

-- Dragging Support (Works on Touch and Mouse)
local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos

MainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = MainFrame.Position

        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

MainFrame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end
end)

scripts.code:
--[[
    RUCK INSPECTOR AIO
    Version: 0.1.0
    UI: WindUI 1.6.66

    Features:
    - ESP labels for Mobs, Chests, Shrines, Camps, Resources, Pickups
    - Per-category toggle, max distance and type filter
    - Mob species detected from name (Cow_1 -> Cow, Goblin_10 -> Goblin)
    - Optional highlights (Roblox only renders 31 at once, so nearest 30)
    - Diagnostics: type census, folder inspection, nearest object inspector
    - Single-instance guard (re-executing replaces the old copy)
    - RightShift / RightControl window toggle

    Target: Roblox Player
]]

--==================================================
-- INITIALIZATION
--==================================================

local VERSION = "0.1.0"
local WINDUI_VERSION = "1.6.66"
local startedAt = os.clock()

local WindUI = nil
local Window = nil
local Container = nil

local Connections = {}
local Entries = {} -- [instance] = entry

local CONTAINER_NAME = "RuckInspectorVisuals"

local CONFIG = {
    Version = VERSION,
    WindUIVersion = WINDUI_VERSION,
    MaxLogs = 60,
    Notifications = true,
}

local Settings = {
    Highlights = false,
    MaxHighlights = 30,
    ShowDistance = true,
    ShowHealth = true,
    ScanInterval = 1.5,
}

local State = {
    Running = true,
    Logs = {},
    TotalCreated = 0,
    TotalRemoved = 0,
    LastScan = "Never",
    LastScanClock = 0,
    ScanDirty = true,
}

--==================================================
-- SINGLE INSTANCE GUARD
--==================================================

local ENV = (type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv()) or _G
local INSTANCE_KEY = "__RuckInspector"

local function sweepOrphans()
    local parents = {}

    if type(gethui) == "function" then
        pcall(function()
            table.insert(parents, gethui())
        end)
    end

    pcall(function()
        table.insert(parents, game:GetService("CoreGui"))
    end)

    pcall(function()
        local lp = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
        local pg = lp and lp:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
        if pg then
            table.insert(parents, pg)
        end
    end)

    for _, parent in ipairs(parents) do
        pcall(function()
            while true do
                local found = parent:FindFirstChild(CONTAINER_NAME)
                if not found then
                    break
                end
                found:Destroy()
            end
        end)

local function loadWindUI()
    if type(loadstring) ~= "function" then
        error("Executor does not expose loadstring.")
    end

    local sourceUrl =
        "https://github.com/Footagesus/WindUI/releases/download/"
        .. WINDUI_VERSION .. "/main.lua"

    local response = game:HttpGet(sourceUrl)

    if type(response) ~= "string" or #response < 1000 then
        error("Invalid WindUI download response.")
    end

    local chunk, compileError = loadstring(response)

    if not chunk then
        error("WindUI compilation failed: " .. tostring(compileError))
    end

    local ok, result = pcall(chunk)

    if not ok then
        error("WindUI initialization failed: " .. tostring(result))
    end

    if type(result) ~= "table"
        or type(result.CreateWindow) ~= "function" then

        error("WindUI CreateWindow API unavailable.")
    end

    return result
end

local function toSet(list)

    if type(list) == "string" then
        set[list] = true
    elseif type(list) == "table" then
        for key, value in pairs(list) do
            if type(value) == "string" then
                set[value] = true

            end
        end
    end

    return set
end

--==================================================
-- GENERAL HELPERS
--==================================================

local function resolvePath(path)
    local current = Workspace

    for _, name in ipairs(path) do
        current = current and current:FindFirstChild(name)
    end

    return current
end

local function typeOf(name)
    local base = tostring(name)

    base = base:gsub("%s*%(%d+%)$", "")
    base = base:match("^(.-)_%d+$") or base

    return base
end

local function colorFor(cat, typeName)
    if TYPE_COLORS[typeName] then
        return TYPE_COLORS[typeName]
    end

    if typeName:find("^BossShrine") then
        return Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 160)
    end

    return cat.Color
end

local function isTypeVisible(cat, cs, typeName)
    if cat.KnownSet[typeName] then
        return cs.Selected[typeName] == true
    end

    -- Unknown / newly discovered types are always shown.
    return true
end

-- Returns only the top-most Models / BaseParts under root
-- (a part inside a model is not listed separately).
local function getTopLevel(root)
    local results = {}

    if not root then
        return results
    end

    for _, descendant in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant:IsA("Model") or descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
            local nested = false
            local parent = descendant.Parent

            while parent and parent ~= root do
                if parent:IsA("Model") or parent:IsA("BasePart") then
                    nested = true
                    break
                end

                parent = parent.Parent
            end

            if not nested then
                table.insert(results, descendant)
            end
        end
    end

    return results
end

local function getAdornPart(obj)
    if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
        return obj
    end

    if obj:IsA("Model") then
        if obj.PrimaryPart then
            return obj.PrimaryPart
        end

        for _, descendant in ipairs(obj:GetDescendants()) do
            if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
                return descendant
            end
        end
    end

    return nil
end

local function getPosition(obj)
    local ok, pos = pcall(function()
        return obj:GetPivot().Position
    end)

    if ok then
        return pos
    end

    return nil
end

local function getOrigin()
    local character = LocalPlayer and LocalPlayer.Character
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if root then
        return root.Position
    end

    local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera

    if camera then
        return camera.CFrame.Position
    end

    return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
end

local function countParts(obj)
    local count = 0

    for _, descendant in ipairs(obj:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
            count += 1
        end
    end

    return count
end

local function removeHighlight(entry)
    if entry.Highlight then
        pcall(function()
            entry.Highlight:Destroy()
        end)

        entry.Highlight = nil
    end
end

local function ensureHighlight(entry)
    if entry.Highlight and entry.Highlight.Parent then
        return
    end

    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")

    highlight.Name = "RuckESPHighlight"
    highlight.Adornee = entry.Obj
    highlight.FillColor = entry.Color
    highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    highlight.FillTransparency = 0.7
    highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
    highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    highlight.Parent = Container

    entry.Highlight = highlight
end

local function removeEntry(obj)
    local entry = Entries[obj]

    if not entry then
        return
    end

    removeHighlight(entry)

    if entry.Gui then
        pcall(function()
            entry.Gui:Destroy()
        end)
    end

    Entries[obj] = nil
    State.TotalRemoved += 1
end

local function clearAllEntries()
    for obj in pairs(Entries) do
        removeEntry(obj)
    end

    table.clear(Entries)
end

local function removeCategoryEntries(cat)
    for obj, entry in pairs(Entries) do
        if entry.Cat == cat then
            removeEntry(obj)
        end
    end
end

local function createEntry(cat, obj, typeName)
    local part = getAdornPart(obj)

    if not part then
        return
    end

    local height = 3

    pcall(function()
        if obj:IsA("Model") then
            height = obj:GetExtentsSize().Y / 2
        else
            height = obj.Size.Y / 2
        end
    end)

    height = math.clamp(height + 1.5, 2, 30)

    local color = colorFor(cat, typeName)

    local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")

    gui.Name = "RuckESPLabel"
    gui.Adornee = part
    gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 20)
    gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, height, 0)
    gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
    gui.LightInfluence = 0
    gui.Parent = Container

    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")

    label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = typeName
    label.TextColor3 = color
    label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
    label.TextSize = 14
    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    label.Parent = gui

    local humanoid = nil

    if obj:IsA("Model") then
        humanoid = obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    end

    Entries[obj] = {
        Obj = obj,
        Cat = cat,
        Type = typeName,
        Part = part,
        Gui = gui,
        Label = label,
        Color = color,
        Humanoid = humanoid,
        Dist = 0,
        Text = "",
    }

    State.TotalCreated += 1
end

local function buildText(entry)
    local text = entry.Type
    local note = TYPE_NOTES[entry.Type]

    if note then
        text = text .. " (" .. note .. ")"
    end

    if Settings.ShowDistance then
        text = text .. " [" .. math.floor(entry.Dist) .. "m]"
    end

    if Settings.ShowHealth then
        local health, maxHealth

        if entry.Humanoid and entry.Humanoid.Parent then
            health = entry.Humanoid.Health
            maxHealth = entry.Humanoid.MaxHealth
        else
            local attrHealth = entry.Obj:GetAttribute("Health")
            local attrMax = entry.Obj:GetAttribute("MaxHealth")

            if type(attrHealth) == "number" then
                health = attrHealth
                maxHealth = type(attrMax) == "number" and attrMax or nil
            end
        end

        if health then
            if maxHealth then
                text = text .. " " .. math.floor(health) .. "/" .. math.floor(maxHealth)
            else
                text = text .. " " .. math.floor(health) .. "hp"
            end
        end
    end

    return text
end

--==================================================
-- SCANNING
--==================================================

local function requestScan()
    State.ScanDirty = true
end

local missingWarned = {}

local function scanAll()
    local origin = getOrigin()

    for _, cat in ipairs(CATEGORIES) do
        local cs = CatState[cat.Key]

        if not cs.Enabled then
            removeCategoryEntries(cat)
        else
            local root = resolvePath(cat.Path)

            if not root then
                removeCategoryEntries(cat)

                if not missingWarned[cat.Key] then
                    missingWarned[cat.Key] = true
                    addLog(cat.Title .. " folder not found: Workspace." .. table.concat(cat.Path, "."))
                end
            else
                missingWarned[cat.Key] = nil

                local seen = {}

                for _, obj in ipairs(getTopLevel(root)) do
                    local typeName = typeOf(obj.Name)

                    if isTypeVisible(cat, cs, typeName) then
                        local pos = getPosition(obj)

                        if pos and (pos - origin).Magnitude <= cs.MaxDistance then
                            seen[obj] = true

                            if not Entries[obj] then
                                createEntry(cat, obj, typeName)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                for obj, entry in pairs(Entries) do
                    if entry.Cat == cat and not seen[obj] then
                        removeEntry(obj)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    State.LastScan = os.date("%H:%M:%S")
end

local function updateEntries()
    local origin = getOrigin()
    local list = {}

    for obj, entry in pairs(Entries) do
        local cs = CatState[entry.Cat.Key]

        if not cs.Enabled or not obj:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
            removeEntry(obj)
        else
            if not entry.Part or not entry.Part:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
                entry.Part = getAdornPart(obj)

                if entry.Part then
                    entry.Gui.Adornee = entry.Part
                end
            end

            local pos = getPosition(obj)

            if not entry.Part or not pos then
                removeEntry(obj)
            else
                entry.Dist = (pos - origin).Magnitude

                local text = buildText(entry)

                if text ~= entry.Text then
                    entry.Text = text
                    entry.Label.Text = text
                end

                table.insert(list, entry)
            end
        end
    end

    if Settings.Highlights then
        table.sort(list, function(a, b)
            return a.Dist < b.Dist
        end)

        for index, entry in ipairs(list) do
            if index <= Settings.MaxHighlights then
                ensureHighlight(entry)
            else
                removeHighlight(entry)
            end
        end
    else
        for _, entry in ipairs(list) do
            removeHighlight(entry)
        end
    end
end

local function inspectPath(path)
    local label = "Workspace." .. table.concat(path, ".")
    local folder = resolvePath(path)

    print("\n========== " .. label .. " ==========")

    if not folder then
        print("Not found.")
        addLog(label .. " not found.")
        return
    end

    local models, parts, folders = 0, 0, 0
    local descendants = folder:GetDescendants()

    for _, object in ipairs(descendants) do
        if object:IsA("Model") then
            models += 1
        elseif object:IsA("BasePart") then
            parts += 1
        elseif object:IsA("Folder") then
            folders += 1
        end
    end

    print("Direct children:", #folder:GetChildren())
    print("Total descendants:", #descendants)
    print("Models:", models, "BaseParts:", parts, "Folders:", folders)
    print("\nDirect children:")

    for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
        print(child.Name, "[" .. child.ClassName .. "]", "Children:", #child:GetChildren())
    end

    print("==========================================\n")

    addLog(label .. " inspection completed.")
end

local function inspectWorkspaceOverview()
    print("\n========== WORKSPACE OVERVIEW ==========")

    for _, child in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
        print(child.Name, "[" .. child.ClassName .. "]", "Children:", #child:GetChildren())
    end

    print("========================================\n")

    addLog("Workspace overview printed.")
end

local function inspectObject(obj)
    if not obj then
        return
    end

    print("\n========== OBJECT STRUCTURE ==========")

    print("Name:", obj.Name)
    print("Class:", obj.ClassName)
    print("FullName:", obj:GetFullName())

    local pos = getPosition(obj)
    print("Position:", pos and tostring(pos) or "Unknown")

    if obj:IsA("Model") then
        print("PrimaryPart:", obj.PrimaryPart and obj.PrimaryPart.Name or "None")
        print("Direct children:", #obj:GetChildren())
        print("Total descendants:", #obj:GetDescendants())
        print("BaseParts:", countParts(obj))

        local humanoid = obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

        if humanoid then
            print("Humanoid:", humanoid.Health .. "/" .. humanoid.MaxHealth)
        else
            print("Humanoid: None")
        end
    end

    local attributes = {}

    pcall(function()
        attributes = obj:GetAttributes()
    end)

    print("\nAttributes:")

    local hasAttributes = false

    for key, value in pairs(attributes) do
        hasAttributes = true
        print("  " .. tostring(key) .. " =", value)
    end

    if not hasAttributes then
        print("  (none)")
    end

    local function printHierarchy(parent, depth)
        if depth > 8 then
            print(string.rep("  ", depth) .. "... depth limit")
            return
        end

        for _, child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
            print(string.rep("  ", depth) .. child.Name, "[" .. child.ClassName .. "]")
            printHierarchy(child, depth + 1)
        end
    end

    print("\nHierarchy:")
    printHierarchy(obj, 0)

    print("======================================\n")
end

local function inspectNearest()
    local origin = getOrigin()
    local nearest, nearestDist, nearestCat = nil, math.huge, nil

    for _, cat in ipairs(CATEGORIES) do
        local root = resolvePath(cat.Path)

        for _, obj in ipairs(getTopLevel(root)) do
            local pos = getPosition(obj)

            if pos then
                local dist = (pos - origin).Magnitude

                if dist < nearestDist then
                    nearest, nearestDist, nearestCat = obj, dist, cat
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if not nearest then
        addLog("No nearby objects found.")
        return
    end

    print(("Nearest object: %s (%s) at %d studs"):format(
        nearest.Name, nearestCat.Title, math.floor(nearestDist)
    ))

    inspectObject(nearest)
    addLog("Inspected nearest object: " .. nearest.Name)
end

local function typeCensus()
    print("\n========== TYPE CENSUS ==========")

    for _, cat in ipairs(CATEGORIES) do
        local root = resolvePath(cat.Path)

        print("\n[" .. cat.Title .. "] Workspace." .. table.concat(cat.Path, "."))

        if not root then
            print("  Folder not found.")
        else
            local counts = {}
            local total = 0

            for _, obj in ipairs(getTopLevel(root)) do
                local typeName = typeOf(obj.Name)
                counts[typeName] = (counts[typeName] or 0) + 1
                total += 1
            end

            local names = {}

            for name in pairs(counts) do
                table.insert(names, name)
            end

            table.sort(names)

            print("  Total objects:", total)

            for _, name in ipairs(names) do
                print(
                    "  " .. name,
                    counts[name],
                    cat.KnownSet[name] and "" or "<-- NEW (not in filter list)"
                )
            end
        end
    end

    print("\n=================================\n")

    addLog("Type census completed.")
end

--==================================================

local TOGGLE_KEYS = {
    [Enum.KeyCode.RightShift] = true,
    [Enum.KeyCode.RightControl] = true,
}

local windowOpen = true
local lastToggle = 0

local function toggleWindow()
    if os.clock() - lastToggle < 0.15 then
        return
    end

    lastToggle = os.clock()

    local ok = pcall(function()
        Window:Toggle()
    end)

    if not ok then
        if windowOpen then
            ok = pcall(function()
                Window:Close()
            end)
        else
            ok = pcall(function()
                Window:Open()
            end)
        end
    end

    if ok then
        windowOpen = not windowOpen
        log("Window toggled.")
    else
        warn("[Ruck Inspector] Could not toggle window (no Toggle/Open/Close method).")
    end
end

trackConnection(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
        return
    end

    if not TOGGLE_KEYS[input.KeyCode] then
        return
    end

    if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
        return
    end

    toggleWindow()
end))

            State.ScanDirty = false
            State.LastScanClock = os.clock()

            local ok, err = pcall(scanAll)

            if not ok then
                addLog("Scan error: " .. tostring(err))
            end
        end

        task.wait(0.25)
    end
end)

-- Update loop: distances, health text, highlight ranking.

    end
end)

--==================================================
-- CLEANUP / UNLOAD
--==================================================

local function unload()
    if not State.Running then
        return
    end

    State.Running = false

    if ENV[INSTANCE_KEY] and ENV[INSTANCE_KEY].Unload == unload then
        ENV[INSTANCE_KEY] = nil
    end

    clearAllEntries()
    disconnectAll()

    if Container then
        pcall(function()
            Container:Destroy()
        end)
    end

    addLog("Inspector unloading.")

    local destroyed = false

    for _, methodName in ipairs({ "Destroy", "Close" }) do
        local method = Window and Window[methodName]

        if type(method) == "function" then
            local ok = pcall(function()
                method(Window)
            end)

            if ok then
                destroyed = true
                break
            end
        end
    end

    if not destroyed then
        warn("[Ruck Inspector] Window cleanup method unavailable.")
    end

    print("[Ruck Inspector] Unload completed.")
end

-- Register this instance so the next execution can replace it.
ENV[INSTANCE_KEY] = { Unload = unload }

SettingsTab:Button({
    Title = "Unload UI",
    Icon = "power",
    Callback = unload,
})

local function IsOverButton(Position)
	local Objects = LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(Position.X, Position.Y)
	for _, Object in ipairs(Objects) do
		if Object:IsA("GuiButton") and Object.Visible then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

MainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(Input)
	if IsClosing or IsAnimating then return end
	if Input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and Input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
	if IsOverButton(Input.Position) then return end

	Dragging = true
	DragStart = Input.Position
	StartPosition = MainFrame.Position

	Input.Changed:Connect(function()
		if Input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
			Dragging = false
		end
	end)
end)

MainFrame.InputChanged:Connect(function(Input)
	if Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		DragInput = Input
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(Input)
	if not Dragging or Input ~= DragInput then return end

	local Delta = Input.Position - DragStart
	if Delta.Magnitude < DragThreshold then return end

	MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
		StartPosition.X.Scale,
		StartPosition.X.Offset + Delta.X,
		StartPosition.Y.Scale,
		StartPosition.Y.Offset + Delta.Y
	)
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(Input)
	if Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		Dragging = false
	end
end)

local function SelectTab(Name)
	if SelectedTab == Name then return end
	SelectedTab = Name
	for TabName, Page in pairs(Tabs) do
		local Selected = TabName == Name
		local Button = TabButtons[TabName]
		Page.Visible = Selected
		Tween(Button, FastTween, {
			BackgroundColor3 = Selected and ActiveTabColor or InactiveTabColor,
			TextColor3 = Selected and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(170, 160, 190)
		})
	end
end

local function CreateTab(Name, Icon)
	local Button = Instance.new("TextButton")
	Button.Name = Name .. "TabButton"
	Button.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
	Button.BackgroundColor3 = InactiveTabColor
	Button.Text = Icon .. "    " .. Name
	Button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 160, 190)
	Button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
	Button.TextSize = 13
	Button.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	Button.AutoButtonColor = false
	Button.Parent = TabContainer
	Corner(Button, 7)

	local ButtonPadding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	ButtonPadding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 12)
	ButtonPadding.Parent = Button

	local Page = Instance.new((Name == "Main" or Name == "Settings") and "ScrollingFrame" or "Frame")
	Page.Name = Name .. "Page"
	Page.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	Page.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	Page.BorderSizePixel = 0
	Page.Visible = false
	Page.Parent = Content

	if Name == "Main" or Name == "Settings" then
		Page.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		Page.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
		Page.ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y
		Page.ScrollBarThickness = 4
		Page.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Purple
		Page.Active = true
	end

	Tabs[Name] = Page
	TabButtons[Name] = Button

	Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if not IsClosing then
			SelectTab(Name)
		end
	end)

	Button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		if SelectedTab ~= Name then
			Tween(Button, FastTween, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 45, 72)})
		end
	end)

	Button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		if SelectedTab ~= Name then
			Tween(Button, FastTween, {BackgroundColor3 = InactiveTabColor})
		end
	end)

	return Page
end

local function UpdateFrameColors(ThemeColor)
	local DarkColor = ThemeColor:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 20), 0.48)
	local PanelColor = ThemeColor:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 20), 0.30)
	local CardColor = ThemeColor:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 20), 0.18)
	local StrokeColor = ThemeColor:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.28)

	MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = DarkColor
	Body.BackgroundColor3 = DarkColor
	Header.BackgroundColor3 = ThemeColor:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.25)
	Sidebar.BackgroundColor3 = PanelColor
	Content.BackgroundColor3 = PanelColor
	ThemeMenu.BackgroundColor3 = PanelColor

	local Cards = {
		AutoCard,
		AutoThrowCard,
		AutoTrainingCard,
		KeybindCard,
		ColorCard,
		AntiAFKCard
	}

	for _, Card in ipairs(Cards) do
		if Card and Card.Parent then
			Card.BackgroundColor3 = CardColor
		end
	end

	SidebarStroke.Color = StrokeColor
	ContentStroke.Color = StrokeColor
	ThemeMenuStroke.Color = StrokeColor
	MainStroke.Color = StrokeColor

	for _, Object in ipairs(ScreenGui:GetDescendants()) do
		if Object:IsA("UIStroke") then
			if Object.Parent ~= AutoPerfectButton
				and Object.Parent ~= AutoThrowButton
				and Object.Parent ~= AutoTrainingButton then
				Object.Color = StrokeColor
			end
		elseif Object:IsA("UIGradient") then
			Object.Color = ColorSequence.new({
				ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, ThemeColor:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.18)),
				ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, ThemeColor),
				ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, ThemeColor:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.25))
			})
		end
	end

	for _, Button in ipairs(ThemeButtons) do
		if Button and Button.Parent then
			Button.BackgroundColor3 = CardColor
		end
	end

	CurrentTheme = ThemeColor
end

local function ToggleGUI()
	if IsClosing or IsAnimating then return end

	IsAnimating = true

	if MainFrame.Visible then
		local ScaleTween = Tween(MainScale, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
			Scale = 0.82
		})

		Tween(MainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
			GroupTransparency = 1
		})

		ScaleTween.Completed:Wait()

		if not IsClosing then
			MainFrame.Visible = false
		end
	else
		MainFrame.Visible = true
		MainScale.Scale = 0.82
		MainFrame.GroupTransparency = 1

		local ScaleTween = Tween(MainScale, TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			Scale = 1
		})

		Tween(MainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			GroupTransparency = 0
		})

		ScaleTween.Completed:Wait()
	end

	IsAnimating = false
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(Input, GameProcessed)
	if IsClosing then return end
	if Input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end

	if AwaitingKeybind then
		if Input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
			AwaitingKeybind = false
			KeybindButton.Text = ToggleKey.Name
			Notify("Keybind selection cancelled!")
			return
		end

		if Input.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
			ToggleKey = Input.KeyCode
			AwaitingKeybind = false
			KeybindButton.Text = ToggleKey.Name
			Notify("GUI toggle key changed to " .. ToggleKey.Name)
		end

		return
	end

	if not IsPC or GameProcessed then return end

	if Input.KeyCode == ToggleKey then
		ToggleGUI()
	end
end)

local function TeleportToStarterArea()
	local StarterArea = workspace:FindFirstChild("StarterArea")
	if not StarterArea then return false end

	local TargetPart
	if StarterArea:IsA("BasePart") then
		TargetPart = StarterArea
	else
		TargetPart = StarterArea.PrimaryPart or StarterArea:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	end

	if not TargetPart then return false end

	local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
	local Humanoid = Character and Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local Root = Character and Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	if not Character or not Humanoid or not Root then return false end

	local HeightOffset = Humanoid.HipHeight + Root.Size.Y / 2
	local TargetPosition = TargetPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, TargetPart.Size.Y / 2 + HeightOffset, 0)
	local TargetCFrame = CFrame.new(TargetPosition) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(Root.Orientation.Y), 0)

	Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	Root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	Character:PivotTo(TargetCFrame + Vector3.new(0, 1.3, 0))
	Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 13, 0)

	return true
end

local function GetTrainingSpot()
	local LocalPlotProps = workspace:FindFirstChild("LocalPlotProps", true)
	if not LocalPlotProps then return nil end

	local TrainingArea = LocalPlotProps:FindFirstChild("TrainingArea")
	if not TrainingArea then return nil end

	local TrainingSpot = TrainingArea:FindFirstChild("TrainingSpot")
	if TrainingSpot and TrainingSpot:IsA("BasePart") then
		return TrainingSpot
	end

	return nil
end

local function TeleportToTrainingSpot()
	local TargetPart = GetTrainingSpot()
	if not TargetPart then return false end

	local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
	local Humanoid = Character and Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local Root = Character and Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	if not Character or not Humanoid or not Root then return false end

	local Center = TargetPart.Position
	local HeightOffset = TargetPart.Size.Y / 2 + Humanoid.HipHeight + Root.Size.Y / 2 + 3

	local TargetPosition = Vector3.new(
		Center.X,
		Center.Y + HeightOffset,
		Center.Z
	)

	local LookVector = Root.CFrame.LookVector
	local TargetCFrame = CFrame.lookAt(
		TargetPosition,
		TargetPosition + Vector3.new(LookVector.X, 0, LookVector.Z)
	)

	Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	Root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

	Character:PivotTo(TargetCFrame)

	Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 13, 0)

	task.wait(0.075)

	if Root.Parent then
		local CurrentPosition = Root.Position
		local CenterPosition = Vector3.new(Center.X, CurrentPosition.Y, Center.Z)

		Character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(CenterPosition) * (TargetCFrame - TargetCFrame.Position))
	end

	return true
end


local function IsTrainingActive()
	local TrainingSequence = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("TrainingSequence", true)
	if TrainingSequence and TrainingSequence:IsA("ScreenGui") and TrainingSequence.Enabled then
		return true
	end

	local TrainingGui = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("TraningGui", true)
	if TrainingGui and TrainingGui:IsA("ScreenGui") and TrainingGui.Enabled then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

local function AutoTapBonus()
	local TrainingSequence = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("TrainingSequence", true)
	if not TrainingSequence then return nil end

	local TapBonus = TrainingSequence:FindFirstChild("TapBonus", true)

	if not TapBonus then
		local TapBonusLayer = TrainingSequence:FindFirstChild("TapBonusLayer", true)
		if TapBonusLayer then
			TapBonus = TapBonusLayer:FindFirstChild("TapBonus", true)
		end
	end

	if not TapBonus then return nil end
	if not TapBonus:IsA("GuiObject") then return nil end
	if not TapBonus.Visible then return nil end
	if TapBonus.AbsoluteSize.X <= 1 or TapBonus.AbsoluteSize.Y <= 1 then return nil end

	local Parent = TapBonus.Parent

	while Parent and Parent ~= PlayerGui do
		if Parent:IsA("GuiObject") and not Parent.Visible then
			return nil
		end

		if Parent:IsA("ScreenGui") and not Parent.Enabled then
			return nil
		end

		Parent = Parent.Parent
	end

	return TapBonus
end

local function ClickTapBonus(Button)
	if not Button or not Button.Parent then return false end
	if not Button:IsA("GuiButton") then return false end
	if not Button.Visible or not Button.Active then return false end

	local Position = Button.AbsolutePosition
	local Size = Button.AbsoluteSize

	if Size.X <= 1 or Size.Y <= 1 then return false end

	local CenterX = Position.X + Size.X / 2
	local CenterY = Position.Y + Size.Y / 2

	local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not Camera then return false end

	local Viewport = Camera.ViewportSize

	if CenterX < 0 or CenterY < 0 or CenterX > Viewport.X or CenterY > Viewport.Y then
		return false
	end

	return pcall(function()
		VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(CenterX, CenterY, 0, true, game, 1)
		task.wait(0.025)
		VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(CenterX, CenterY, 0, false, game, 1)
	end)
end

	if IsClosing then return end

	if not AutoTrainingEnabled then
		local ThrowSequence = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("ThrowSequence", true)

		if AutoEnabled or AutoThrowEnabled then

local RenderConnection

RenderConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if (not AutoEnabled and not AutoThrowEnabled) or IsClosing then
		PreviousMarkerTop = nil
		WasAboveTop = false
		return
	end

	local ThrowSequence = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("ThrowSequence")
	if not ThrowSequence or not ThrowSequence.Enabled then
		PreviousMarkerTop = nil
		WasAboveTop = false
		return
	end

	local Meter = ThrowSequence:FindFirstChild("Meter")
	local Bar = Meter and Meter:FindFirstChild("Bar")
	local Marker = Bar and Bar:FindFirstChild("Marker")
	local Stripes = Bar and Bar:FindFirstChild("Stripes")

	if not Marker or not Marker:IsA("GuiObject") or not Marker.Visible or not Stripes or not Stripes:IsA("GuiObject") or not Stripes.Visible then
		PreviousMarkerTop = nil
		WasAboveTop = false
		return
	end

	local MarkerTop = Marker.AbsolutePosition.Y
	local MarkerBottom = MarkerTop + Marker.AbsoluteSize.Y
	local StripesTop = Stripes.AbsolutePosition.Y

	if Marker.AbsoluteSize.Y <= 0 or Stripes.AbsoluteSize.Y <= 0 then
		PreviousMarkerTop = nil
		WasAboveTop = false
		return
	end

	local IsMovingUp = PreviousMarkerTop ~= nil and MarkerTop < PreviousMarkerTop
	local HasReachedTop = PreviousMarkerTop ~= nil
		and PreviousMarkerTop > StripesTop
		and MarkerTop <= StripesTop
		and MarkerBottom >= StripesTop

	if IsMovingUp and HasReachedTop and not WasAboveTop and tick() - LastClickTime >= 0.2 then
		WasAboveTop = true
		LastClickTime = tick()

		task.spawn(function()
			if not IsClosing and (AutoEnabled or AutoThrowEnabled) then
				ClickScreen()
			end
		end)
	end

	if MarkerTop > StripesTop then
		WasAboveTop = false
	end

	PreviousMarkerTop = MarkerTop
end)

scripts.summary: Features: - Crouch/Slide Button (C) - Slide can only be activated if speed is above 20 - ⁠Inclines increase speed, declines decrease speed (Uphill +speed, downhill -speed) - ⁠Customizable script Script Suggestions: Sprint Button and stam…
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ContentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
if player:GetAttribute("CrouchSlideLoaded") then return end
player:SetAttribute("CrouchSlideLoaded", true)

local Slide_At = 20
local Crouch_Hip, Slide_Hip, Crouch_Speed = 1.85, 1.3, 0.55
local hitbox_Y, hitbox_Size = 0.5, Vector3.new(2, 1, 1)
local crouch_top = hitbox_Y + hitbox_Size.Y * 0.5
local scan_radius = 8
local FLAT_DECEL, UPHILL_DECEL, DOWNHILL_ACCEL = 12, 52, 46

local CROUCH_IMG = "rbxassetid://109660173469064"
local CROUCH_DOWN = "rbxassetid://105987157375274"
local SLIDE_IMG = "rbxassetid://110954069432063"
local SLIDE_DOWN = "rbxassetid://134994664343117"
local ANIMS = {
	idle = "rbxassetid://109602961761132",
	walk = "rbxassetid://134301743319119",
	run = "rbxassetid://77522194791234",
}
local SLIDE_ANIM = "rbxassetid://125545085077300"
local SLIDE_SOUND = "rbxassetid://18952286141"

local State = { Stand = "Stand", Crouch = "Crouch", Slide = "Slide" }

local character, humanoid, hrp, animator
local originalHip, savedSpeed = 2, 16
local collider, colliderWeld
local origCollide, origQuery = {}, {}
local state, crouchOn, slowedSpeed = State.Stand, false, nil
local hipLock = false
local tracks, crouchName, slideTrack, slideSound = {}, nil, nil, nil
local slideDir, slideVel, slideTime, fading = Vector3.zAxis, 0, 0, false
local velocity, attachment, lastToggle = nil, nil, 0
local button, gui
local disabledParts, origPartCollide = {}, {}
local onToggle

local function flatSpeed()
	if not hrp then return 0 end
	local v = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	return Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z).Magnitude
end

local function readSpeed()
	if not humanoid or not hrp then return 0 end
	local vel = flatSpeed()
	return humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05 and math.max(vel, humanoid.WalkSpeed) or vel
end

local function grounded()
	if not humanoid then return false end
	local s = humanoid:GetState()
	return s ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall and s ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping and humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
end

local function usable()
	if not humanoid or not hrp or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
	local s = humanoid:GetState()
	return s ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead and s ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated and s ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming and s ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing
end

local function rayParams()
	local p = RaycastParams.new()
	p.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	p.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }
	p.RespectCanCollide = true
	return p
end

local function setAttributes()
	if character then
		character:SetAttribute("Crouching", state == State.Crouch)
		character:SetAttribute("Sliding", state == State.Slide)
	end
end

local function syncCollider()
	if colliderWeld and humanoid then
		colliderWeld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, hitbox_Y - humanoid.HipHeight, 0)
	end
end

local function setPose(hip)
	if not humanoid or not humanoid.Parent then return end
	local target = hip or originalHip
	if math.abs(humanoid.HipHeight - target) > 0.001 then
		hipLock = true
		humanoid.HipHeight = target
		hipLock = false
	end
	syncCollider()
end

local function restoreOverhang()
	for p in pairs(disabledParts) do
		if p.Parent then p.CanCollide = origPartCollide[p] ~= false end
	end
	disabledParts, origPartCollide = {}, {}
end

local function disableOverhang()
	if not hrp or not humanoid then return end
	local lowerBound = hrp.Position.Y - humanoid.HipHeight + crouch_top + 0.03
	local upperBound = hrp.Position.Y + 3
	for p in pairs(disabledParts) do
		if not p.Parent or (p.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude > scan_radius * 3 then
			if p.Parent then p.CanCollide = origPartCollide[p] ~= false end
			disabledParts[p], origPartCollide[p] = nil, nil
		end
	end
	if upperBound <= lowerBound then return end
	local params = OverlapParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character, workspace.CurrentCamera }
	params.MaxParts = 200
	local ok, parts = pcall(function()
		return workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(
			CFrame.new(hrp.Position.X, (lowerBound + upperBound) * 0.5, hrp.Position.Z),
			Vector3.new(scan_radius * 2, upperBound - lowerBound, scan_radius * 2),
			params
		)
	end)
	if not ok or not parts then return end
	for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
		if p.Parent and not disabledParts[p] and p.CanCollide and not p:IsDescendantOf(character) then
			local cf, sz = p.CFrame, p.Size
			local lowestY = cf.Position.Y
				- sz.Y * 0.5 * math.abs(cf.UpVector.Y)
				- sz.Z * 0.5 * math.abs(cf.LookVector.Y)
				- sz.X * 0.5 * math.abs(cf.RightVector.Y)
			if lowestY >= lowerBound and lowestY <= upperBound then
				disabledParts[p], origPartCollide[p], p.CanCollide = true, p.CanCollide, false
			end
		end
	end
end

local function disableBody()
	for part in pairs(origCollide) do
		if part.Parent then
			part.CanCollide, part.CanQuery = false, false
		end
	end
	if collider then collider.CanCollide, collider.CanQuery = true, true end
end

local function enableBody()
	for part, orig in pairs(origCollide) do
		if part.Parent then
			part.CanCollide = orig
			part.CanQuery = origQuery[part] ~= false
		end
	end
	if collider then collider.CanCollide, collider.CanQuery = false, false end
end

local function stopCrouch(fade)
	for _, track in pairs(tracks) do
		if track.IsPlaying then track:Stop(fade or 0.15) end
	end
	crouchName = nil
end

local function playCrouch(name)
	local track = tracks[name]
	if not track then return end
	if crouchName ~= name then
		for n, other in pairs(tracks) do
			if n ~= name and other.IsPlaying then other:Stop(0.15) end
		end
		track:Play(0.15, 1, 1)
		crouchName = name
	end
	local speed = flatSpeed()
	track:AdjustSpeed(name == "walk" and math.clamp(speed / 8, 0.65, 1.5) or name == "run" and math.clamp(speed / 18, 0.75, 1.45) or 1)
end

local function updateCrouchAnim()
	if state ~= State.Crouch then return end
	local speed = flatSpeed()
	playCrouch(speed < 0.75 and "idle" or speed < 16 and "walk" or "run")
end

local function loadTracks()
	tracks, crouchName, slideTrack = {}, nil, nil
	if not animator then return end
	for name, id in pairs(ANIMS) do
		local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
		anim.AnimationId = id
		local ok, track = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(anim) end)
		if ok and track then
			track.Priority, track.Looped, tracks[name] = Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement, true, track
		end
	end
	local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
	anim.AnimationId = SLIDE_ANIM
	local ok, track = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(anim) end)
	if ok and track then
		track.Priority, track.Looped, slideTrack = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4, true, track
	end
end

local function freezeSlide()
	if not slideTrack or not slideTrack.IsPlaying or slideTrack.Length <= 0.05 then return end
	local at = math.min(0.6, math.max(slideTrack.Length - 0.04, 0))
	if slideTrack.TimePosition >= at then
		slideTrack.TimePosition = at
		if slideTrack.Speed ~= 0 then slideTrack:AdjustSpeed(0) end
	end
end

local function startSound()
	if not hrp then return end
	if slideSound then slideSound:Destroy() end
	slideSound = Instance.new("Sound")
	slideSound.Name, slideSound.SoundId, slideSound.Looped, slideSound.Volume = "SlideLoop", SLIDE_SOUND, true, 0.6
	slideSound.RollOffMode, slideSound.RollOffMaxDistance = Enum.RollOffMode.Linear, 70
	slideSound.Parent = hrp
	slideSound:Play()
end

local function stopSound(fade)
	local s = slideSound
	slideSound = nil
	if not s then return end
	if fade and s.Parent then
		local tw = TweenService:Create(s, TweenInfo.new(0.22), { Volume = 0 })
		tw:Play()
		tw.Completed:Connect(function() s:Stop(); s:Destroy() end)
	else
		s:Stop(); s:Destroy()
	end
end

local function clearMover()
	if velocity then velocity:Destroy(); velocity = nil end
	if attachment then attachment:Destroy(); attachment = nil end
end

local function findJump()
	local pg = player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
	local touch = pg and pg:FindFirstChild("TouchGui")
	local frame = touch and touch:FindFirstChild("TouchControlFrame")
	return frame and frame:FindFirstChild("JumpButton")
end

local function refreshButton()
	if not button then return end
	local pressed = state == State.Crouch or (state == State.Slide and crouchOn)
	local sliding = state == State.Slide or (state ~= State.Crouch and readSpeed() >= Slide_At)
	button.Image = sliding and (pressed and SLIDE_DOWN or SLIDE_IMG) or (pressed and CROUCH_DOWN or CROUCH_IMG)
end

local function layoutButton()
	if not button or not gui then return end
	local jump = findJump()
	button.Visible = UserInputService.TouchEnabled and jump ~= nil
	if not button.Visible then return end
	local pos, size = jump.AbsolutePosition, jump.AbsoluteSize
	if size.X < 2 then return end
	button.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size.X, size.Y)
	button.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pos.X - gui.AbsolutePosition.X - math.max(8, size.X * 0.18), pos.Y - gui.AbsolutePosition.Y + size.Y * 0.5)
end

local function ensureGui()
	if gui and gui.Parent then return end
	gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name, gui.ResetOnSpawn, gui.IgnoreGuiInset, gui.DisplayOrder = "CrouchSlideGui", false, true, 50
	gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	button = Instance.new("ImageButton")
	button.Name = "CrouchButton"
	button.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
	button.BackgroundTransparency, button.AutoButtonColor = 1, false
	button.ScaleType, button.Image = Enum.ScaleType.Fit, CROUCH_IMG
	button.Size, button.Visible, button.ZIndex = UDim2.fromOffset(70, 70), false, 10
	button.Parent = gui
	button.Activated:Connect(function() onToggle() end)
end

local function facing()
	if not humanoid or not hrp then return Vector3.zAxis end
	local flat = Vector3.new(humanoid.MoveDirection.X, 0, humanoid.MoveDirection.Z)
	if flat.Magnitude > 0.1 then return flat.Unit end
	local vel = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	flat = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z)
	if flat.Magnitude > 2 then return flat.Unit end
	flat = Vector3.new(hrp.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, hrp.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
	return flat.Magnitude > 0.05 and flat.Unit or Vector3.zAxis
end

local function slope()
	if not hrp then return 0 end
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0), Vector3.new(0, -12, 0), rayParams())
	return hit and math.clamp(hit.Normal:Dot(slideDir), -1, 1) or 0
end

local function steerSlide(dt)
	local wish = humanoid and humanoid.MoveDirection or Vector3.zero
	local flat = Vector3.new(wish.X, 0, wish.Z)
	if flat.Magnitude < 0.12 then
		local keys = (UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Left)) and -1 or 0
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Right) then keys += 1 end
		if keys == 0 then return end
		local right = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.RightVector or Vector3.xAxis
		flat = Vector3.new(right.X, 0, right.Z)
		if flat.Magnitude < 0.01 then return end
		flat = flat.Unit * keys
	end
	if flat.Magnitude < 0.01 then return end
	local blended = slideDir:Lerp(flat.Unit, 1 - math.exp(-5.5 * math.clamp(flat.Magnitude, 0, 1) * dt))
	if blended.Magnitude > 0.01 then slideDir = blended.Unit end
end

local function hitWall()
	if not hrp then return false end
	local dist = math.clamp(1.6 + slideVel * 0.05, 1.8, 4.5)
	for _, y in ipairs({ 0.2, 1.3, 2.2 }) do
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, y, 0), slideDir * dist, rayParams())
		if hit and hit.Instance and hit.Instance.CanCollide and hit.Normal.Y < 0.45 then return true end
	end
	return false
end

local function beginFade()
	if fading then return end
	fading = true
	if crouchOn then
		setPose(Crouch_Hip)
		if slideTrack and slideTrack.IsPlaying then slideTrack:Stop(0.22) end
		playCrouch(flatSpeed() >= 16 and "run" or flatSpeed() >= 0.75 and "walk" or "idle")
	else
		setPose(nil)
		if slideTrack and slideTrack.IsPlaying then slideTrack:Stop(0.22) end
		stopCrouch(0.18)
	end
	stopSound(true)
end

local function finishSlide(wall)
	if state ~= State.Slide then return end
	local keep = crouchOn and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0
	if not fading then beginFade() end
	clearMover()
	if humanoid and humanoid.Parent then
		humanoid.AutoRotate = true
		humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, true)
		if wall and hrp then
			local v = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, v.Y, 0)
		end
		if keep then
			state = State.Crouch
			setPose(Crouch_Hip)
			humanoid.WalkSpeed = math.max(6, savedSpeed * Crouch_Speed)
			slowedSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed
			disableBody()
		else
			state, crouchOn = State.Stand, false
			humanoid.WalkSpeed, slowedSpeed = savedSpeed, nil
			setPose(nil)
			stopCrouch(0.16)
			enableBody()
			restoreOverhang()
		end
	else
		state, crouchOn = State.Stand, false
		enableBody()
		restoreOverhang()
	end
	fading = false
	setAttributes()
	refreshButton()
end

local function startSlide(speed)
	savedSpeed, slideDir = humanoid.WalkSpeed, facing()
	slideVel = math.clamp(math.max(speed, flatSpeed(), Slide_At) * 1.5, 24, 100)
	slideTime, fading, state, crouchOn = 0, false, State.Slide, true
	stopCrouch(0.06)
	setPose(Slide_Hip)
	disableBody()
	humanoid.AutoRotate = false
	humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, false)
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0
	local y = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y
	hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(slideDir.X * slideVel, y, slideDir.Z * slideVel)
	hrp.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(hrp.Position, hrp.Position + slideDir)
	clearMover()
	attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Parent = hrp
	velocity = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
	velocity.Attachment0 = attachment
	velocity.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
	velocity.ForceLimitMode = Enum.ForceLimitMode.PerAxis
	velocity.MaxAxesForce = Vector3.new(1e5, 0, 1e5)
	velocity.VectorVelocity = Vector3.new(slideDir.X * slideVel, 0, slideDir.Z * slideVel)
	velocity.Parent = hrp
	if slideTrack then slideTrack:Play(0.08, 1, 1); slideTrack:AdjustSpeed(1) end
	startSound()
	setAttributes()
	refreshButton()
end

local function enterCrouch()
	if state == State.Stand then savedSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed end
	state, crouchOn = State.Crouch, true
	setPose(Crouch_Hip)
	disableBody()
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = math.max(6, savedSpeed * Crouch_Speed)
	slowedSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed
	setAttributes()
	refreshButton()
	updateCrouchAnim()
end

local function exitCrouch()
	state, crouchOn = State.Stand, false
	stopCrouch(0.15)
	setPose(nil)
	enableBody()
	restoreOverhang()
	if humanoid and humanoid.Parent then
		if slowedSpeed and math.abs(humanoid.WalkSpeed - slowedSpeed) < 0.4 then humanoid.WalkSpeed = savedSpeed end
		humanoid.AutoRotate = true
		humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, true)
	end
	slowedSpeed = nil
	setAttributes()
	refreshButton()
end

onToggle = function()
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - lastToggle < 0.1 then return end
	lastToggle = now
	if not usable() then return end
	if state == State.Slide then
		crouchOn = false
		finishSlide(true)
	elseif state == State.Crouch then
		exitCrouch()
	elseif grounded() then
		local speed = readSpeed()
		if speed >= Slide_At then startSlide(speed) else enterCrouch() end
	end
end

local function updateSlide(dt)
	if state ~= State.Slide or not humanoid or not hrp or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		if state == State.Slide then crouchOn = false; finishSlide(false) end
		return
	end
	if slideTime > 0.18 and flatSpeed() < 4 and slideVel > 12 then finishSlide(true); return end
	slideTime += dt
	steerSlide(dt)
	local grade = slope()
	slideVel = math.clamp(slideVel + ((grade > 0.03 and grade * DOWNHILL_ACCEL or 0) - (FLAT_DECEL + (grade < -0.03 and -grade * UPHILL_DECEL or 0))) * dt, 0, 110)
	humanoid.WalkSpeed, humanoid.AutoRotate = 0, false
	if velocity then velocity.VectorVelocity = Vector3.new(slideDir.X * slideVel, 0, slideDir.Z * slideVel) end
	local y = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y
	hrp.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(hrp.Position, hrp.Position + slideDir)
	hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(slideDir.X * slideVel, y, slideDir.Z * slideVel)
	if hitWall() then finishSlide(true); return end
	if not fading and slideVel < 11 then beginFade() end
	if (slideTime > 0.35 and slideVel <= 5) or slideTime >= 7 then finishSlide(false) end
end

local function destroyCollider()
	if collider then collider:Destroy(); collider = nil end
	colliderWeld, origCollide, origQuery = nil, {}, {}
end

local function createCollider(char, root)
	collider = Instance.new("Part")
	collider.Name, collider.Size, collider.Transparency = "LowHitbox", hitbox_Size, 1
	collider.CanCollide, collider.CanQuery, collider.CanTouch, collider.Massless = false, false, false, true
	collider.Parent = char
	colliderWeld = Instance.new("Weld")
	colliderWeld.Part0, colliderWeld.Part1 = root, collider
	colliderWeld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, hitbox_Y - (humanoid and humanoid.HipHeight or originalHip), 0)
	colliderWeld.Parent = collider
	origCollide, origQuery = {}, {}
	for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") and d ~= root and d ~= collider then
			origCollide[d], origQuery[d] = d.CanCollide, d.CanQuery
		end
	end
end

local function teardown()
	clearMover()
	stopSound(false)
	stopCrouch(0)
	if slideTrack and slideTrack.IsPlaying then slideTrack:Stop(0) end
	enableBody()
	restoreOverhang()
	destroyCollider()
	if humanoid and humanoid.Parent then
		pcall(function()
			hipLock = true
			humanoid.HipHeight = originalHip
			hipLock = false
			humanoid.AutoRotate = true
			humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, true)
			if slowedSpeed and math.abs(humanoid.WalkSpeed - slowedSpeed) < 0.4 then humanoid.WalkSpeed = savedSpeed end
		end)
	end
	state, crouchOn, fading, slowedSpeed, tracks, slideTrack = State.Stand, false, false, nil, {}, nil
end

local function setup(char)
	local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
	local root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
	if not hum or not root or player.Character ~= char then return end
	char:WaitForChild("Animate", 5)
	task.wait(0.15)
	if player.Character ~= char or not hum.Parent then return end
	teardown()
	character, humanoid, hrp = char, hum, root
	animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or hum:WaitForChild("Animator", 5)
	originalHip = hum.HipHeight > 0.05 and hum.HipHeight or 2
	savedSpeed, state, crouchOn = hum.WalkSpeed, State.Stand, false
	loadTracks()
	createCollider(char, root)
	syncCollider()
	setAttributes()
	refreshButton()
	char.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
		if d:IsA("BasePart") and d ~= collider and d ~= root and origCollide[d] == nil then
			origCollide[d], origQuery[d] = d.CanCollide, d.CanQuery
			if state ~= State.Stand then d.CanCollide, d.CanQuery = false, false end
		end
	end)
	hum:GetPropertyChangedSignal("HipHeight"):Connect(function()
		if not hipLock and humanoid then syncCollider() end
	end)
	hum.Died:Connect(function()
		if character ~= char then return end
		crouchOn = false
		if state == State.Slide then finishSlide(false) end
		teardown()
	end)
	hum.Jumping:Connect(function(active)
		if character == char and active and state == State.Crouch then exitCrouch() end
	end)
	hum.Seated:Connect(function(active)
		if character ~= char or not active or state == State.Stand then return end
		crouchOn = false
		if state == State.Slide then finishSlide(false) end
		if state == State.Crouch then exitCrouch() end
	end)
end

task.spawn(function()
	local assets = {}
	for _, id in pairs(ANIMS) do
		local a = Instance.new("Animation")
		a.AnimationId = id
		table.insert(assets, a)
	end
	local a, s = Instance.new("Animation"), Instance.new("Sound")
	a.AnimationId, s.SoundId = SLIDE_ANIM, SLIDE_SOUND
	table.insert(assets, a)
	table.insert(assets, s)
	pcall(function() ContentProvider:PreloadAsync(assets) end)
end)

ensureGui()
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if processed or UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.C then onToggle() end
end)

pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("CrouchSlidePose") end)
RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function(dt)
	syncCollider()
	if state == State.Crouch or state == State.Slide then
		disableBody()
		disableOverhang()
	end
	if state == State.Slide then updateSlide(dt) end
end)
RunService:BindToRenderStep("CrouchSlidePose", Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value, function()
	layoutButton()
	refreshButton()
	if state == State.Slide then freezeSlide() elseif state == State.Crouch then updateCrouchAnim() end
end)

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char) task.spawn(setup, char) end)
if player.Character then task.spawn(setup, player.Character) end

local function ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local parts = {}
    local lastIndex = 1
    
    for codeStart, language, code, codeEnd in message:gmatch("()```([%w]*)\n?(.-)\n?```()") do
        if codeStart > lastIndex then
            local textBefore = message:sub(lastIndex, codeStart - 1)
            if textBefore:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
                table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textBefore})
            end
        end
        
        table.insert(parts, {type = "code", content = code, language = language})
        lastIndex = codeEnd
    end
    
    if lastIndex <= #message then
        local textAfter = message:sub(lastIndex)
        if textAfter:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
            table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textAfter})
        end
    end
    
    if #parts == 0 then
        table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = message})
    end
    
    return parts
end


local function DisplayAIResponse(message)
    local parts = ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local senderAdded = false
    
    for i, part in ipairs(parts) do
        if part.type == "text" then
            if not senderAdded then
                AddMessage(currentAI, part.content, false)
                senderAdded = true
            else
                AddMessage("", part.content, false)
            end
        elseif part.type == "code" then
            CreateCodeBlock(part.content, part.language)
        end
    end
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
local RootPart = Character.HumanoidRootPart

local stages = workspace.stages
local currentstage = LocalPlayer.leaderstats.Stage

local function FindNextPortal()
	for i,v in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if v.Name == "Stage Teleport" and #v:GetChildren() == 4 then
			local enter = v:FindFirstChild("enter")
			if enter ~= nil then
				return enter
			end
		end
	end
end

local function Touch(Part)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 0)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 1)
end
while task.wait() do
	local CurrentStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value))
	local NextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	local NextNextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame * CFrame.new(0,3,0)
	if NextStage then
		Touch(NextStage)
		--Potential Speed Gain?
		if NextNextStage then
			Touch(NextNextStage)
		end
	else
		local NextPortal = FindNextPortal()
		if NextPortal then
			RootPart.CFrame = NextPortal.CFrame
		else
			RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
end
for i,v in pairs(workspace.badges:GetChildren()) do
	if v.Name == "Platform" then
		Touch(v)
	end
end

local function setupCharacter(character)
    local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
    animation.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://72722244508749"
    local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator", humanoid)
    local animTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)

    screenGui:ClearAllChildren()

    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 100)
    frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -100, 0.5, -50)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.Parent = screenGui
    frame.Active = true
    frame.Draggable = true

    local playBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    playBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 40)
    playBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
    playBtn.Text = "Play Animation"
    playBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 130, 180)
    playBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    playBtn.Parent = frame

    playBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        animTrack:Play()
    end)

    local keybindBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    keybindBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 40)
    keybindBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 50)
    keybindBtn.Text = currentKey and ("Set Keybind (Current: " .. tostring(currentKey) .. ")") or "Set Keybind (Current: none)"
    keybindBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 50, 150)
    keybindBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    keybindBtn.TextScaled = true
    keybindBtn.Parent = frame

    local waitingForKey = false

    keybindBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        keybindBtn.Text = "Press a key..."
        waitingForKey = true
    end)

    UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
        if waitingForKey and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
            currentKey = input.KeyCode
            keybindBtn.Text = "Set Keybind (Current: " .. tostring(currentKey) .. ")"
            waitingForKey = false
        elseif currentKey and input.KeyCode == currentKey and not gameProcessed then
            animTrack:Play()
        end
    end)
end

end
