local function setScale(newScale)
	currentScale = math.clamp(newScale, 0.4, 3.0)
	timerScale.Scale = currentScale
	scaleValueBtn.Text = math.round(currentScale * 100) .. "%"
end

minusBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setScale(currentScale - 0.1) end)
plusBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setScale(currentScale + 0.1) end)
scaleValueBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setScale(1.0) end)

local isResizing = false
local resizeStartPos = nil
local startScale = 1

resizeHandle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		isResizing = true
		resizeStartPos = input.Position
		startScale = currentScale
	end
end)

local function makeDraggable(frame)
	local dragging = false
	local dragStart = nil
	local startPos = nil

	frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) and not isResizing then
			dragging = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = frame.Position
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			if isResizing then
				dragging = false
				return
			end
			local delta = input.Position - dragStart
			frame.Position = UDim2.new(
				startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
				startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
			)
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = false
		end
	end)
end

makeDraggable(timerFrame)
makeDraggable(settingsFrame)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if isResizing and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
		local delta = input.Position - resizeStartPos
		local scaleChange = delta.X / BASE_WIDTH
		setScale(startScale + scaleChange)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		isResizing = false
	end
end)

local function formatTime(seconds)
	local mins = math.floor(seconds / 60)
	local secs = math.floor(seconds % 60)
	local ms = math.floor((seconds * 100) % 100)
	return string.format('%02d:%02d.<font size="36">%02d</font>', mins, secs, ms)
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)
	if isRunning then
		elapsedTime += deltaTime
		timerLabel.Text = formatTime(elapsedTime)
	end
end)

closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	settingsFrame.Visible = false
	waitingForBind = nil
end)

openSettingsBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	settingsFrame.Visible = not settingsFrame.Visible
	waitingForBind = nil
end)

toggleBindBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	waitingForBind = "Toggle"
	toggleBindBtn.Text = "..."
	resetBindBtn.Text = resetKey.Name
end)

resetBindBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	waitingForBind = "Reset"
	resetBindBtn.Text = "..."
	toggleBindBtn.Text = toggleKey.Name
end)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then return end
	
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
		if waitingForBind == "Toggle" then
			toggleKey = input.KeyCode
			toggleBindBtn.Text = toggleKey.Name
			waitingForBind = nil
			return
		elseif waitingForBind == "Reset" then
			resetKey = input.KeyCode
			resetBindBtn.Text = resetKey.Name
			waitingForBind = nil
			return
		end
		
		if input.KeyCode == toggleKey then
			isRunning = not isRunning
		elseif input.KeyCode == resetKey then
			isRunning = false
			elapsedTime = 0
			timerLabel.Text = formatTime(0)
		end
	end
end)
